passages.sub: O My Lord, Send Blessings Upon Muhammad…
passages.ar: الضِّيَاءُ اللَّامِعُ بِذِكْرِ مَوْلِدِ النَّبِيِّ الشَّافِعِ
passages.tr: Adl-dliyâ`ul-lâmi’u bidzikri maulidin-nabiyyisy-syâfi’i
passages.id_: Sinar yang Berkilau: Mengenang Momen Kelahiran Nabi Sang Pemberi Syafaat
passages.en: The Gleaming Radiance: Remembering the Moment of the Birth of the Prophet, the Intercessor.

passages.sub: O My Lord, Send Blessings Upon Muhammad…
passages.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ حَبِيْبِكَ الشَّافِعِ الْمُشَفَّعْ
passages.tr: Yâ rabbi shalli ‘alâ Muḫammad ۞ ḫabîbikasy-syâfi‘il-musyaffa’
passages.id_: Ya Rabb limpahkanlah rahmat atas Nabi Muhammad ﷺ. Kekasih-Mu pemberi syafaat yang diharapkan syafaatnya.
passages.en: O Lord, pour mercy upon Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. Your beloved, the intercessor whose intercession is hoped for.

passages.sub: O My Lord, Send Blessings Upon Muhammad…
passages.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ أَعْلَى الْوَرَى رُتْبَةً وأَرْفَعْ
passages.tr: Yâ rabbi shalli ‘alâ Muḫammad ۞ a‘lal-warâ rutbatan wa arfa‘
passages.id_: Ya Rabb limpahkanlah rahmat atas Nabi Muhammad ﷺ. Manusia yang teramat sangat luhur derajatnya.
passages.en: O Lord, pour mercy upon Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. The man of the most exceedingly lofty rank.

passages.sub: O My Lord, Send Blessings Upon Muhammad…
passages.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ أَسْمَى الْبَرَايَا جَاهًا وَأَوْسَعْ
passages.tr: Yâ rabbi shalli ‘alâ Muḫammad ۞asmal-barâyâ jâhan wa ausa‘
passages.id_: Ya Rabb limpahkanlah rahmat atas Nabi Muhammad ﷺ. Makhluk yang sangat tinggi dan luas kedudukannya.
passages.en: O Lord, pour mercy upon Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. The creature of the highest and most far-reaching station.

passages.sub: O My Lord, Send Blessings Upon Muhammad…
passages.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ وَاسْلُكْ بِنَا رَبِّ خَيْرَ مَهْيَعْ
passages.tr: Yâ rabbi shalli ‘alâ Muḫammad ۞ wasluk binâ rabbi khaira mahya‘
passages.id_: Ya Rabb limpahkanlah rahmat atas Nabi Muhammad ﷺ. Wahai Tuhan, bimbinglah kami ke jalan yang terbaik.
passages.en: O Lord, pour mercy upon Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. O Lord, guide us to the best of paths.

passages.sub: O My Lord, Send Blessings Upon Muhammad…
passages.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ وَعَافِنَا وَاشْفِ كُلَّ مُوْجَعْ
passages.tr: Yâ rabbi shalli ‘alâ Muḫammad ۞ wa ‘âfinâ wasyfi kulla mûja‘
passages.id_: Ya Rabb limpahkanlah rahmat atas Nabi Muhammad ﷺ. Sembuhkanlah kami dari segala derita penyakit.
passages.en: O Lord, pour mercy upon Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. Heal us of every suffering of illness.

passages.sub: O My Lord, Send Blessings Upon Muhammad…
passages.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ وَأَصْلِحِ الْقَلبَ وَاعْفُ وَانفَعْ
passages.tr: Yâ rabbi shalli ‘alâ Muḫammad ۞ wa ashliḫil-qalba wa‘fu wanfa‘
passages.id_: Ya Rabb limpahkanlah rahmat atas Nabi Muhammad ﷺ. Perbaikilah hati, ampunilah, dan berilah kami (segala yang) manfaat.
passages.en: O Lord, pour mercy upon Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. Mend our hearts, forgive us, and grant us (all that is) beneficial.

passages.sub: O My Lord, Send Blessings Upon Muhammad…
passages.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ وَاكْفِ الْمُعَادِيْ وَاصْرِفْهُ وَارْدَعْ
passages.tr: Yâ rabbi shalli ‘alâ Muḫammad ۞ wakfil-mu‘âdi washrifhu warda‘
passages.id_: Ya Rabb limpahkanlah rahmat atas Nabi Muhammad ﷺ. Bentengilah dan hindarkanlah kami dari musuh-musuh yang datang pada kami.
passages.en: O Lord, pour mercy upon Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. Fortify us and shield us from the enemies who come against us.

passages.sub: O My Lord, Send Blessings Upon Muhammad…
passages.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ نَحِلُّ فِي حِصْنِكَ الْمُمَنَّعْ
passages.tr: Yâ rabbi shalli ‘alâ Muḫammad ۞ naḫillu fî ḫishnikal-mumanna‘
passages.id_: Ya Rabb limpahkanlah rahmat atas Nabi Muhammad ﷺ. Kami singgah di dalam Benteng-Mu yang melindungi (dari berbagai macam gangguan).
passages.en: O Lord, pour mercy upon Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. We take shelter within Your protecting Fortress (from every kind of harm).

passages.sub: O My Lord, Send Blessings Upon Muhammad…
passages.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ رَبِّ ارْضَ عَنَّا رِضَاكَ الْأَرْفَعْ
passages.tr: Yâ rabbi shalli ‘alâ Muḫammad ۞ rabbir-dlâ ‘annâ ridlâkal-arfa‘
passages.id_: Ya Rabb limpahkanlah rahmat atas Nabi Muhammad ﷺ. Ya Allah ridhailah kami dengan keridhaan-Mu yang agung.
passages.en: O Lord, pour mercy upon Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. O Allah, be pleased with us with Your magnificent pleasure.

passages.sub: O My Lord, Send Blessings Upon Muhammad…
passages.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ وَاجْعَلْ لَنَا فِي الْجِنَانِ مَجْمَعْ
passages.tr: Yâ rabbi shalli ‘alâ Muḫammad ۞ waj‘al lanâ fil-jinâni majma‘
passages.id_: Ya Rabb limpahkanlah rahmat atas Nabi Muhammad ﷺ. Jadikanlah kami sebagai orang-orang yang akan berkumpul dengan nabi-Mu di surga.
passages.en: O Lord, pour mercy upon Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. Make us among those who will gather with Your Prophet in Paradise.

passages.sub: O My Lord, Send Blessings Upon Muhammad…
passages.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ رَافِقْ بِنَا خَيْرَ خَلْقِكَ اجْمَعْ
passages.tr: Yâ rabbi shalli ‘alâ Muḫammad ۞ râfiq binâ khaira khalqikaj-ma‘
passages.id_: Ya Rabb limpahkanlah rahmat atas Nabi Muhammad ﷺ. Jadikanlah kami selalu bersama-sama dengan sebaik-baik ciptaan-Mu (Nabi Muhammad ﷺ).
passages.en: O Lord, pour mercy upon Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. Make us ever together with the best of Your creation (Prophet Muhammad ﷺ).

passages.sub: O My Lord, Send Blessings Upon Muhammad…
passages.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ و سَلِّمْ
passages.tr: Yâ rabbi shalli ‘alâ Muḫammad ۞ yâ rabbi shalli ‘alaihi wa sallim
passages.id_: Ya Rabb limpahkanlah rahmat atas Nabi Muhammad ﷺ. Ya Allah limpahkanlah rahmat dan kesalamatan kepada beliau ﷺ.
passages.en: O Lord, pour mercy upon Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. O Allah, pour mercy and peace upon him ﷺ.

passages.sub: O My Lord, Send Blessings Upon Muhammad…
passages.ar: اَللّٰهمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّم وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى اٰلِهِ
passages.tr: ﴾Allâhumma shalli wa sallim wa bârik ‘alaihi wa ‘ala âlihi﴿
passages.id_: Ya Allah limpahkanlah rahmat keagungan, keselamatan, serta keberkahan kepada Nabi dan keluarganya.
passages.en: O Allah, pour the mercy of majesty, peace, and blessing upon the Prophet and his family.

passages.sub: Truly We Have Granted Victory…
passages.ar: أَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
passages.tr: A‘ûdzu billâhi manasy-syaithânir-rajîmi
passages.id_: Aku berlindung kepada Allah dari godaan setan yang terkutuk.
passages.en: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed devil.

passages.sub: Truly We Have Granted Victory…
passages.ar: أَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
passages.tr: Bismillâhirraḫmânirraḫîmi
passages.id_: Aku berlindung kepada Allah dari godaan setan yang terkutuk.
passages.en: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed devil.

passages.sub: Truly We Have Granted Victory…
passages.ar: اِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُّبِيْنًاۙ لِّيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللّٰهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْۢبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهٗ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَاطًا مُّسْتَقِيْمًاۙ وَّيَنْصُرَكَ اللّٰهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيْزًا لَقَدْ جَاۤءَكُمْ رَسُوْلٌ مِّنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ عَزِيْزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيْصٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ رَءُوْفٌ رَّحِيْمٌ فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللّٰهُ لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَۗ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ إِنَّ اللّٰهَ وَمَلٰۤىِٕكَتَهٗ يُصَلُّوْنَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّۗ يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا صَلُّوْا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوْا تَسْلِيْمًا
passages.tr: Innâ fataḫnâ laka fatḫnâm mubîna. liyaghfira lakallâhu mâ taqaddama min dzanbika wa mâ ta'akhkhara wa yutimma ni‘matahu ‘alaika wa yahdîyaka shirâthan mustaqîman, wa yanshurakallâhu nashran ‘azîzan. wa laqad jâ'akum rasûlun min anfusikum ‘azîzun ‘alaihi mâ ‘anittum ḫarîshun ‘alaikum bil-mu'minîna ra'ûfun raḫîm. fa in tawallau faqul ḫasbiyyallâhu lâ ilâha illâ huwa ‘alaihi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbul-‘arsyil ‘adhîm, innalllâha wa malâ'ikatahu yushallûna ‘alan-nabî, yâ ayyuhal-ladzîna âmanû shallû ‘alaihi wa sallimû taslîmâ.
passages.id_: Sungguh Kami telah menganugerahkan kepadamu kemenangan yang nyata, agar Allah memberikan ampunan kepadamu (Nabi Muhammad) atas dosamu yang lalu dan yang akan datang, menyempurnakan nikmat-Nya atasmu, menunjukimu ke jalan yang lurus, dan agar Allah menolongmu dengan pertolongan yang besar. Sungguh, benar-benar telah datang kepadamu seorang rasul dari kaummu sendiri. Berat terasa olehnya penderitaan yang kamu alami, sangat menginginkan (keimanan dan keselamatan) bagimu, dan (bersikap) penyantun dan penyayang terhadap orang-orang mukmin. Jika mereka berpaling (dari keimanan), katakanlah (Nabi Muhammad), “Cukuplah Allah bagiku. Tidak ada tuhan selain Dia. Hanya kepada-Nya aku bertawakal dan Dia adalah Tuhan pemilik ‘Arasy (singgasana) yang agung.” Sesungguhnya Allah dan para malaikat-Nya berselawat untuk Nabi. Wahai orang-orang yang beriman, berselawatlah kamu untuk Nabi dan ucapkanlah salam dengan penuh penghormatan kepadanya.
passages.en: Truly We have granted you a clear victory, that Allah may forgive you (Prophet Muhammad) your past and future sins, complete His favour upon you, guide you to a straight path, and aid you with a mighty aid. Truly there has come to you a messenger from among your own people. Grievous to him is the suffering you undergo; deeply he longs (for faith and safety) for you, and to the believers he is kind and merciful. If they turn away (from faith), say (Prophet Muhammad), 'Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god but He. In Him alone I place my trust, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.' Truly Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet. O you who believe, send blessings upon the Prophet and greet him with full honour.

passages.sub: Truly We Have Granted Victory…
passages.ar: ﴿اَللّٰهمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وعَلَى اٰلِهِ﴾
passages.tr: ﴾Allâhumma shalli wa sallim wa bârik ‘alaihi wa ‘ala âlihi﴿
passages.id_: Ya Allah limpahkanlah rahmat keagungan, keselamatan, serta keberkahan kepada Nabi dan keluarganya.
passages.en: O Allah, pour the mercy of majesty, peace, and blessing upon the Prophet and his family.

passages.sub: Part I: All Praise to Allah Who…
passages.ar: اَلْحَمْـــــدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ هَـدَانَا ۞ بِعَبْدِهِ الْمُخْتَـــارِ مَنْ دَعَانَـــا
passages.tr: Al-ḫamdulillâhil-ladzî hadânâ ۞ bi‘abdihil-mukhtâri man da‘ânâ
passages.id_: Segala puji hanyalah untuk Allah yang telah memberi kita petunjuk. Melalui Hamba-Nya yang telah terpilih ﷺ yang telah menyeru kami.
passages.en: All praise is due to Allah alone, who has given us guidance — through His chosen servant ﷺ who called us.

passages.sub: Part I: All Praise to Allah Who…
passages.ar: إلَيْـــــهِ بِالْإذْنِ وَقَدْ نَــادَانَا ۞ لَبَّيْكَ يَـــا مَنْ دَلَّنَا وَحَدَانَـــا
passages.tr: Ilaihi bil-idzni wa qad nâdânâ ۞ labbaika yâ man dallanâ wa ḫadânâ
passages.id_: Kepada-Nya dengan izin-Nya, dan sungguh Beliau ﷺ telah menyeru kami. Kami memenuhi panggilanmu, wahai Nabi ﷺ yang telah menyampaikan petunjuk dan motivasi kepada kami.
passages.en: To Him, by His leave; and truly he ﷺ has called us. We answer your call, O Prophet ﷺ, who conveyed to us guidance and encouragement.

passages.sub: Part I: All Praise to Allah Who…
passages.ar: صَلَّى عَلَيْــــكَ اللهُ بَــــارِئُكَ الَّذِيْ ۞ بِكَ يَا مُشَفَّعُ خَصَّنَا وَحَبَانَا
passages.tr: Shallâ ‘alaikallâhu bâri’ukal-ladzî ۞ bika yâ musyaffa‘u khashshanâ wa ḫabânâ
passages.id_: Semoga Allah melimpahkan rahmat kepadamu yang telah menciptakanmu. Wahai yang diharapkan syafaatnya, sebab engkau kami spesial dan terberkahi.
passages.en: May Allah pour mercy upon you — the One who created you. O you whose intercession is hoped for, for through you we are made special and blessed.

passages.sub: Part I: All Praise to Allah Who…
passages.ar: مَعْ آلِكَ الْأَطْهَـــارِ مَعْـــدِنِ سِرِّكَ ۞ الْأَسْمَى فَهُمْ سُفُنُ النَّجَاةِ حِمَانَا
passages.tr: Ma‘ âlikal-athhâri ma‘dini sirrika ۞ al-asmâ fahum sufunun-najâti ḫimânâ
passages.id_: (Semoga Allah melimpahkan rahmat) juga kepada para keluargamu yang suci sebagai sumber-sumber rahasiamu yang mulia, merekalah kapal-kapal penyelamat yang melindungi kami.
passages.en: (May Allah pour mercy) also upon your pure family, the wellsprings of your noble secrets — they are the rescuing ships that shelter us.

passages.sub: Part I: All Praise to Allah Who…
passages.ar: وعَلَى صَحَـابَتِكَ الْكِرَامِ حُمَــاةِ دِيـْـ ۞ ـــنِكَ أَصْبَحُوا لِوَلَائِهِ عُنْوَانَــا
passages.tr: Wa ‘alâ shaḫâbatikal-kirâmi ḫumâti dî- ۞ nika ashbaḫû liwâ’ihi ‘unwânâ
passages.id_: (Semoga Allah melimpahkan rahmat) pula kepada para sahabatmu yang mulia, yang menjadi pembela ajaranmu, dan menjadi contoh panutan bagi pecintanya ﷺ.
passages.en: (May Allah pour mercy) too upon your noble companions, who became the defenders of your teaching and role models for those who love you ﷺ.

passages.sub: Part I: All Praise to Allah Who…
passages.ar: وَالتَّابِعِينَ لَهُمْ بِصِدْقٍ مَـا حَدَى ۞ حَادِي الْمَوَدَّةِ هَيَّجَ الْأشْجَــانَا
passages.tr: Wat-tâbi’îna lahum bishidqin mâ ḫadâ ۞ ḫâdil-mawaddati hayyajal-asyjânâ
passages.id_: (Semoga Allah melimpahkan rahmat) juga kepada para tabi’in, yang mengikuti mereka dengan benar, sebesar senandung rasa cinta yang mengguncang kesedihan.
passages.en: (May Allah pour mercy) also upon the tabi'in, who followed them in truth — as great as the chant of love that shakes away sorrow.

passages.sub: Part I: All Praise to Allah Who…
passages.ar: وَاللهِ مَا ذُكِرَ الْحَبِيبُ لَدَى الْمُحِبِّ ۞ إِلَّا وَأَضْحَى وَالِهًـــا نَشْوَانَا
passages.tr: Wallâhi mâ dzukiral-ḫabîbu ladal-muḫibbi ۞ illâ wa adlḫâ wa ilâhan nasywânâ
passages.id_: Demi Allah tidaklah disebutkan nama sang kekasih ﷺ pada orang yang mencintainya, kecuali dia akan terhenyak dan dimabuk rindu kepadanya (Rasulullah ﷺ).
passages.en: By Allah, the name of the beloved ﷺ is never mentioned to one who loves him but that he is struck breathless and intoxicated with longing for him (the Messenger of Allah ﷺ).

passages.sub: Part I: All Praise to Allah Who…
passages.ar: أَيْنَ الْمُحِـــــبُّونَ الَّذِيْنَ عَلَيْــهِـــــــمُ ۞ بَذْلُ النُّفُوسِ مَعَ النَّفَائِسِ هَانَا
passages.tr: Ainal-muḫibbûnal-ladzîna ‘alaihimu ۞ badzlun-nufûsi ma‘an-nafâ’isi hânâ
passages.id_: Di manakah mereka para pecinta, yang rela mengorbankan jiwa raga serta harta bendanya yang hina itu?
passages.en: Where are they — the lovers who gladly sacrifice their souls, bodies, and their lowly wealth?

passages.sub: Part I: All Praise to Allah Who…
passages.ar: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ بِذِكْرِ طَهَ الْمُصْطَفَى ۞ إِلَّا بِهِ انْتَعَشُوا وَأَذْهَبَ رَانَا
passages.tr: Lâ yasma‘ûna bidzikri thahal-mushthafâ ۞ illâ bihin-ta‘asyû wa adzhaba rânâ
passages.id_: Tidaklah mereka mendengar sebutan Thâhâ al-Musthafa ﷺ, kecuali bangkitlah kembali semangatnya dan lenyaplah segala kesedihannya.
passages.en: They hear no mention of Ta-Ha al-Mustafa ﷺ but that their zeal revives and all their sorrow vanishes.

passages.sub: Part I: All Praise to Allah Who…
passages.ar: فَاهْتَاجَتِ الْأَرْوَاحُ تَشْتَاقُ اللِّقَا ۞ وَتَحِنُّ تَسْــأَلُ رَبَّهَا الرِّضْوَانَـــا
passages.tr: Fahtâjâtil-arwâḫu tasytâqul-liqâ ۞ wa taḫinnu tas’alu rabbahar-ridlwânâ
passages.id_: Bergoncanglah jiwa karena rasa rindu ingin segera berjumpa dan merintih memohon ridha kepada Tuhan-Nya.
passages.en: The soul is shaken with longing to meet him soon, moaning as it pleads for the pleasure of its Lord.

passages.sub: Part I: All Praise to Allah Who…
passages.ar: حَـــالُ الْمُحِبِّــينَ كَذَا فَاسْمَعْ إِلَى ۞ سِيَرِ الْمُشَفَّعِ وَارْهِفِ الْآذَانَا
passages.tr: ḫâlal-muḫibbîna kadzâ fasma‘ ilâ ۞ siyaril-musyaffa‘i warhifil-âdzânâ
passages.id_: Begitulah keadaan para pecinta (Rasul ﷺ) maka dengarkanlah kisah perjalanan hidup al-Musyaffa‘ ﷺ (nabi yang diharapkan syafaatnya) dan tajamkan telinga dengan saksama.
passages.en: Such is the state of the lovers (of the Messenger ﷺ). So listen to the story of the life of al-Musyaffa' ﷺ (the Prophet whose intercession is hoped for), and lend a keen ear.

passages.sub: Part I: All Praise to Allah Who…
passages.ar: وَانْصِتْ إِلَى أَوْصَافِ طَهَ الْمُجْتَبَى ۞ وَاحْضِرْ لِقَلْبِكَ يَمْتَلِئْ وِجْدَانَا
passages.tr: Wanshit ila aushâfi thahal-mujtaba ۞ Waḫdlir liqalbika yamtali wijdânâ
passages.id_: Simaklah dengan teliti sifat-sifat Thâhâ al-Mujtaba ﷺ (sang pilihan), dan hadirkanlah hatimu, niscaya hatimu akan dipenuhi dengan kerinduan.
passages.en: Attend carefully to the traits of Ta-Ha al-Mujtaba ﷺ (the chosen one), and bring your heart present, and it will be filled with longing.

passages.sub: Part I: All Praise to Allah Who…
passages.ar: يَـا رَبَّنَــــا صَلِّ وَسَــــلِّمْ دَائِمًــــا ۞ عَلَى حَبِيْبِكَ مَنْ إِلَيْــــكَ دَعَانَــــا
passages.tr: Yâ rabbi wasallim da’iman ۞ ‘alâ ḫabîbika man ilaika da‘ânâ
passages.id_: Wahai Tuhan kami, limpahkanlah rahmat dan keselamatan selamanya, pada kekasih-Mu yang telah menyeru kami kepada-Mu.
passages.en: O our Lord, pour mercy and peace forever upon Your beloved who called us to You.

passages.sub: Part I: All Praise to Allah Who…
passages.ar: ﴿اَللّٰهمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وعَلَى اٰلِهِ﴾
passages.tr: ﴾Allâhumma shalli wa sallim wa bârik ‘alaihi wa ‘ala âlihi﴿
passages.id_: Ya Allah limpahkanlah rahmat keagungan, keselamatan, serta keberkahan kepada Nabi dan keluarganya.
passages.en: O Allah, pour the mercy of majesty, peace, and blessing upon the Prophet and his family.

passages.sub: Part II: Allah Informed Us…
passages.ar: نَبَّأَنَا اللهُ فَقَــالَ جَــــاءَكُمْ ۞ نُورٌ فَسُبْحَانَ الَّذِيْ أَنْبَانَــــا
passages.tr: Nabba'anallâhu faqâla jâ'akum ۞ nûrun fasubḫânal-ladzî anbânâ
passages.id_: Allah telah memberi kabar kepada kita dengan firman-Nya: “Telah datang kepada kalian An-Nur (cahaya). Mahasuci Allah yang telah memberi kita kabar ini.
passages.en: Allah has given us tidings in His word: 'There has come to you An-Nur (the light).' Glory be to Allah who has given us these tidings.

passages.sub: Part II: Allah Informed Us…
passages.ar: وَالنُّوْرُ طَهَ عَبْدُهُ مَنَّ بِــهِ ۞ فِيْ ذِكْرِهِ أَعْظِمْ بِهِ مَنَّانَــــا
passages.tr: Wan-nûru thaha ‘abduhu manna bihi ۞ fî dzikrihi a‘dhim bihi mannânâ
passages.id_: Cahaya Thâhâ ﷺ hamba-Nya membuat kita dilimpahi karunia ketika menyebutnya. Agungkanlah karunia kami berkat menyebut Nabi Muhammad ﷺ.
passages.en: The light of Ta-Ha ﷺ, His servant, makes us showered with grace when we mention him. So magnify our grace by the mention of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.

passages.sub: Part II: Allah Informed Us…
passages.ar: هُوَ رَحْمَـــةُ الْمَوْلَى تَأَمَّـــــلْ قَوْلَهُ ۞ فَلْيَفْرَحُوْا وَاغْدُ بِهِ فَرْحَانَا
passages.tr: Huwa raḫmatul-maulâ ta'ammal qaulahu ۞ falyafraḫû waghdu bihi farḫânâ
passages.id_: Beliau ﷺ merupakan suatu rahmat dari sang pencipta, maka perhatikanlah Firman-Nya: “Maka bergembiralah kamu”, maka datanglah kebahagiaan kita berkat beliau ﷺ.
passages.en: He ﷺ is a mercy from the Creator, so heed His word: 'So rejoice' — and so our happiness comes through him ﷺ.

passages.sub: Part II: Allah Informed Us…
passages.ar: مُسْتَمْسِكًا بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقَى ومُعْـــ ۞ ـــتَصِمًا بِحَبْلِ اللهِ مَنْ أَنْشَانَا
passages.tr: Mustamsikan bil-‘urwatil-wutsqâ wa mu‘- ۞ tashiman biḫablillâḫi man ansyânâ
passages.id_: Dengan senantiasa berpegangan pada tali yang kuat (Al-Qur’an dan Al-Hadits) dan dengan berpegang teguh pada tali Allah yang menciptakan kita.
passages.en: By ever holding fast to the strong rope (the Qur'an and Hadith), and by clinging firmly to the rope of Allah who created us.

passages.sub: Part II: Allah Informed Us…
passages.ar: وَاسْتَشْعِرَنْ أَنْوَارَ مَنْ قِيلَ مَتَى ۞ كُنتَ نَبِيًّا قَالَ اٰدَمُ كَانَا
passages.tr: Wastasy‘iran anwâra man qîla matâ ۞ kunta nabiyyan qâla âdamu kânâ
passages.id_: Rasakanlah akan kehadiran cahaya-cahaya Rasulullah ﷺ yang ketika dikatakan: “Sejak kapankah Engkau diangkat sebagai nabi?” Beliau menjawab, “Kenabianku semenjak Adam as.”
passages.en: Feel the presence of the lights of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, who, when it was asked, 'Since when were you made a prophet?' answered, 'My prophethood is since (the time of) Adam, upon him be peace.'

passages.sub: Part II: Allah Informed Us…
passages.ar: بَيْنَ التُّرابِ وبَيْنَ مَــاءٍ فَـاسْتَفِقْ ۞ مِنْ غَفْلَةٍ عَنْ ذَا وَكُنْ يَقْظَانَا
passages.tr: Bainat-turâbi wa baina mâ'in fastafiq ۞ min ghaflatin ‘an dzâ wa kun yaqdhânâ
passages.id_: Masih berupa antara air dan tanah, sadarilah olehmu dari kelalaian-kelalaianmu itu dan terjagalah.
passages.en: still between water and clay. So awaken from your heedlessness and be watchful.

passages.sub: Part II: Allah Informed Us…
passages.ar: وَاعْبُرْ إِلَى أَسْـــــرَارِ رَبِّي لَــــمْ يَزَلْ ۞ يَنْقُلُنِي بَيْنَ الْخِيَارِ مُصَانَا
passages.tr: Wa‘bur ilâ asrâri rabbi lam yazal ۞ yanqulunî bainal-khiyâri mushânâ
passages.id_: Maka pahamilah rahasia-rahasia Tuhanku yang selalu memindahkanku ﷺ di antara sulbi orang-orang yang terpilih serta terjaga kesuciannya.
passages.en: So understand the secrets of my Lord, who ever moved me ﷺ among the loins of the chosen ones, kept pure and guarded.

passages.sub: Part II: Allah Informed Us…
passages.ar: لَــمْ تَفْتَرِقْ مِنْ شُعْبَتَيْنِ إِلَّا أَنَــــا ۞ فِي خَيْرِهَا حَتَّى بُرُزِيَ آنَا
passages.tr: Lam taftariq min syu‘bataini illâ anâ ۞ fî khairihâ ḫattâ buruziya ânâ
passages.id_: Tidaklah terpisah dari dua kelompok (suku), terkecuali aku berada pada yang terbaik, begitulah hingga terlahirnya diriku.
passages.en: I was never parted from any two groups (tribes) but that I was in the best of them — so it was until my birth.

passages.sub: Part II: Allah Informed Us…
passages.ar: فَأَنَا خِيَارٌ مِنْ خِيَارٍ قَدْ خَرَجْتُ ۞ مِنْ نِكَاحٍ لِي إلٰهِيَ صَانَا
passages.tr: Fa'anâ khiyârun min khiyârin qad kharajtu ۞ min nikâḫin lî ilâhiya shânâ
passages.id_: Aku adalah yang terpilih dari semua yang terpilih, dan aku terlahir dari pernikahan yang Tuhanku telah menjaganya.
passages.en: I am the chosen of all the chosen, and I was born of a marriage that my Lord had kept pure.

passages.sub: Part II: Allah Informed Us…
passages.ar: طَهَّـــــرَهُ الله حَمَــــــاهُ اخْتَـــــارَهُ ۞ ومَا بَرَى كَمِثْلِهِ إِنْسَــــانَا
passages.tr: Thahharahullâḫu ḫamâhukh-târahu ۞ wa mâ barâ kamitslihi insânâ
passages.id_: Allah telah menyucikannya ﷺ, serta melindungi dan memilihnya ﷺ. Tidaklah pernah Allah menciptakan manusia menyerupainya ﷺ.
passages.en: Allah purified him ﷺ, protected and chose him ﷺ. Never did Allah create a human resembling him ﷺ.

passages.sub: Part II: Allah Informed Us…
passages.ar: وَبِحُبِّـــهِ وَبِذِكْرِهِ وَالنَّصْرِ والتَّـ ۞ ــوْقِيرِْ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ قَدْ أَوْصَانَا
passages.tr: Wa biḫubbihi wa bidzikrihi wan-nashri wat-ta- ۞ uqîra rabbul-‘arsyi qad aushânâ
passages.id_: Dan dengan mencintai dan mengingat serta membantu syari’atnya, dan dengan penghormatan padanya ﷺ Allah Pencipta Arsy telah mewasiatkan kita.
passages.en: And with loving and remembering him and aiding his law, and with honouring him ﷺ, Allah, Creator of the Throne, has enjoined upon us.

passages.sub: Part II: Allah Informed Us…
passages.ar: يَا رَبَّنَــــا صَلِّ وَ سَــلِّمْ دَائِمًـــــا ۞ عَلَى حَبِيْبِكَ مَنْ إِلَيْكَ دَعَانَا
passages.tr: Yâ rabbanâ shalli wa sallim da`iman ۞ ‘alâ ḫabîbika man ilaika da’ânâ
passages.id_: Wahai Tuhan kami, limpahkanlah rahmat dan keselamatan selamanya. pada kekasih-Mu yang telah menyeru kami kepada-Mu.
passages.en: O our Lord, pour mercy and peace forever upon Your beloved who called us to You.

passages.sub: Part II: Allah Informed Us…
passages.ar: ﴿اَللّٰهمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وعَلَى اٰلِهِ﴾
passages.tr: ﴾Allâhumma shalli wa sallim wa bârik ‘alaihi wa ‘ala âlihi﴿
passages.id_: Ya Allah limpahkanlah rahmat keagungan, keselamatan, serta keberkahan kepada Nabi dan keluarganya.
passages.en: O Allah, pour the mercy of majesty, peace, and blessing upon the Prophet and his family.

passages.sub: Part III: Thus, and He Has Spread…
passages.ar: هٰذَا وَقَدْ نَشَرَ الْإِلٰهُ نُعُوْتَهُ ۞ فِي الْكُتْبِ بَيَّنَهَا لَنَا تِبْيَانَا
passages.tr: Hâdzâ wa qad nasyaral-ilâhu nu‘ûtahu ۞ fil-kutbi bayyanahâ lanâ tibyânâ
passages.id_: Begitulah, Tuhan telah menyebarkan tentang sifat-sifatnya ﷺ dalam kitab-kitab (terdahulu) yang menjelaskannya dengan sangat terang.
passages.en: So it is: the Lord has spread word of his traits ﷺ in the (former) Books that describe him most clearly.

passages.sub: Part III: Thus, and He Has Spread…
passages.ar: أَخَـذَ مِيْثَاقَ النَّبِيِّيْنَ لَمَــا ۞ اٰتَيْتُكُمْ مِنْ حِكْمَةٍ إِحْسَانَا
passages.tr: Akhadza mîtsâqan-nabiyyîna lamâ ۞âtaitukum min ḫikmatin iḫsânâ
passages.id_: Dia (Allah) telah mengambil perjanjian dari para nabi ketika telah kudatangkan pada kalian hikmah dan kemuliaan.
passages.en: He (Allah) took a covenant from the prophets: 'When I have brought you wisdom and honour...'

passages.sub: Part III: Thus, and He Has Spread…
passages.ar: وَجَاءَكُمْ رَسُوْلُنَــا لَتُؤْمِنُنَّ ۞ وَتَنْصُرُوْنَ وَتُصْبِحُوْنَ أَعْوَانَا
passages.tr: Wa jâ'akum rasûlunâ latu'minunna ۞ wa tanshurûna wa tushbiḫûna a‘wânâ
passages.id_: Teladah datang utusan kami (Rasulullah ﷺ) pada kalian (wahai para nabi) maka agar kalian (wahai para nabi) beriman padanya, dan kalian (wahai para nabi) mendukungnya ﷺ, dan agar kalian (wahai para nabi) menjadi pengikutnya.
passages.en: '...and a messenger of Ours (the Messenger of Allah ﷺ) has come to you (O prophets), then you (O prophets) shall believe in him and support him ﷺ, and you (O prophets) shall be his followers.'

passages.sub: Part III: Thus, and He Has Spread…
passages.ar: قَدْ بَشَّرُوا أَقْوَامَهُمْ بِالْمُصْطَفَى ۞ أَعْظِمْ بِذٰلِكَ رُتْبَةً وَمَكَانَا
passages.tr: Qad basysyarû aqwâmahum bil-mushthafâ ۞ a‘dhim bidzâlika rutbatan wa makânâ
passages.id_: Para nabi terdahulu telah memberi kabar gembira pada kaum mereka akan kedatangan nabi terpilih, maka muliakanlah martabat dan kedudukkannya.
passages.en: The former prophets gave their peoples glad tidings of the coming of the chosen Prophet. So honour his rank and station.

passages.sub: Part III: Thus, and He Has Spread…
passages.ar: فَهُوَ وَإِنْ جَاءَ الْأَخِيْرُ مُقدَّمٌ ۞ يَمْشُونَ تَحْتَ لِوَاءِ مَنْ نَادَانَا
passages.tr: Fahuwa wa in jâ'al-akhîru muqaddamun ۞ yamsyûna taḫta liwâ'i man nâdânâ
passages.id_: Apabila telah datang hari kiamat, para nabi terdahulu berjalan di bawah naungan panji sang nabi ﷺ yang telah menyeru kita.
passages.en: When the Day of Resurrection comes, the former prophets walk beneath the banner of the Prophet ﷺ who called us.

passages.sub: Part III: Thus, and He Has Spread…
passages.ar: يَا أُمَّةَ الْإِسْلَامِ أَوَّلُ شَــافِعٍ ۞ وَمُشَفَّعٍ أَنَا قَطُّ لَا أَتَوَانَى
passages.tr: Yâ ummatal-islâmi awwalu syâfi‘in ۞ wa musyaffa‘in anâ qaththu lâ atawânâ
passages.id_: Wahai umat Islam, aku adalah yang pertama memberi syafaat dan diharapkan syafaatnya, dan tidaklah sama sekali aku memperlambat (syafaat itu).
passages.en: O Muslims, I am the first to intercede and the one whose intercession is hoped for, and I shall never delay it in the least.

passages.sub: Part III: Thus, and He Has Spread…
passages.ar: حَتَّى أُنَادَى ارْفَعْ وَسَلْ تُعْطَ وَقُلْ ۞ يُسْمَعْ لِقَولِكَ نَجْمُ فَخْرِكْ بَانَا
passages.tr: ḫattâ unâdâr-fa‘ was al tu‘tha wa qul ۞ yusma‘ liqaulika najmu fakhrik bânâ
passages.id_: Hingga diserukan kepadaku (ketika bersujud memohon syafaat), “Angkatlah kepalamu (wahai Muhammad ﷺ), katakanlah permintaanmu, niscaya engkau diberi; bicaralah, niscaya engkau didengar.” Bintang kemuliaanmu (wahai Nabi ﷺ) sungguh jelas dan terang.
passages.en: Until it is called to me (as I prostrate pleading for intercession), 'Raise your head (O Muhammad ﷺ), state your request and it shall be granted; speak, and you shall be heard.' The star of your honour (O Prophet ﷺ) is truly clear and bright.

passages.sub: Part III: Thus, and He Has Spread…
passages.ar: وَلِواءُ حَمْدِ اللهِ جَــلَّ بِيَدِي ۞ وَلَأَوَّلًا اٰتِيْ أَنَا الْجِنَانَا
passages.tr: Wa liwâ'u ḫamdillâhi jalla biyadî ۞ wa la'awwalan âtî anal-jinânâ
passages.id_: Panji pujian kepada Allah yang Mahaperkasa berada di tanganku ﷺ dan aku ﷺ adalah manusia pertama yang mendatangi surga.
passages.en: The banner of praise to Allah the Almighty is in my hand ﷺ, and I ﷺ am the first human to reach Paradise.

passages.sub: Part III: Thus, and He Has Spread…
passages.ar: وَأَكْرَمُ الْخَلْقِ عَلَى اللهِ أَنَــــا ۞ فَلَقَدْ حَبَاكَ اللهُ مِنْهُ حَنَانَا
passages.tr: Wa akramul-khalqi ‘alallâhi anâ ۞ falaqad ḫabbâkallâhu minhu ḫanânâ
passages.id_: Aku ﷺ telah menjadi ciptaan yang paling mulia di sisi Allah. Sungguh engkau (wahai Nabi ﷺ) telah terpelihara oleh Allah dengan kasih sayang-Nya.
passages.en: I ﷺ have become the most honoured of creation in the sight of Allah. Truly you (O Prophet ﷺ) have been kept safe by Allah with His compassion.

passages.sub: Part III: Thus, and He Has Spread…
passages.ar: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيْكَ فَتَرْضَى جَلَّ مِنْ ۞ مُعْطٍ تَقَاصَرَ عَنْ عَطَاهُ نُهَانَا
passages.tr: Wa lasaufa yu‘thîka fatardlâ jalla min ۞ mu‘thin taqâshara ‘an ‘athâhu nuhânâ
passages.id_: “Dan kelak Dia pasti memberikan karunia-Nya kepadamu, hingga engkau puas.” (Ayat ini) merupakan tanda kebesaran Sang Maha Pemberi, yang sukar dijangkau akal.
passages.en: 'And your Lord will surely give you His grace until you are pleased.' (This verse) is a sign of the greatness of the Most Bountiful, beyond the reach of the mind.

passages.sub: Part III: Thus, and He Has Spread…
passages.ar: بِاللهِ كَرِّرْ ذِكْرَ وَصْفِ مُحَمَّدٍ ۞ كَيْمَا تُزِيْحَ عَنِ الْقُلُوبِ الرَّانَا
passages.tr: Billâhi karrir dzikra washfi muḫammadin ۞ kaimâ tuzîḫa ‘anil-qulûbir-rânâ
passages.id_: Demi Allah, ingat-ingatlah sifat Nabi Muhammad ﷺ berulang-ulang, agar menyingkirkan kotoran-kotoran dari hati.
passages.en: By Allah, remember the traits of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ again and again, to sweep the filth from the heart.

passages.sub: Part III: Thus, and He Has Spread…
passages.ar: يَا رَبَّنَــــا صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ دَائِمًــــا ۞ عَلَى حَبِيْبِكَ مَنْ إِلَيْكَ دَعَانَا
passages.tr: Yâ rabbanâ shalli wa sallim da'iman ۞ ‘alâ ḫabîbika man ilaika da‘ânâ
passages.id_: Wahai Tuhan kami, limpahkanlah rahmat dan keselamatan selamanya pada kekasih-Mu yang telah menyeru kami kepada-Mu.
passages.en: O our Lord, pour mercy and peace forever upon Your beloved who called us to You.

passages.sub: Part III: Thus, and He Has Spread…
passages.ar: ﴿اَللّٰهمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وعَلَى اٰلِهِ﴾
passages.tr: ﴾Allâhumma shalli wa sallim wa bârik ‘alaihi wa ‘ala âlihi﴿
passages.id_: Ya Allah limpahkanlah rahmat keagungan, keselamatan, serta keberkahan kepada Nabi dan keluarganya.
passages.en: O Allah, pour the mercy of majesty, peace, and blessing upon the Prophet and his family.

passages.sub: Part IV: When the Time Drew Near…
passages.ar: لَمَّـا دَنَـــا وَقْـتُ الْبُرُوْزِ لِأَحْمَـــدٍ ۞ عَنْ إِذْنِ مَنْ مَـا شَـاءَهُ قَـدْ كَانَـا
passages.tr: Lammâ dânâ waqtul-burûzi li aḫmadin ۞ ‘an idzni man mâ syâ'ahu qad kânâ
passages.id_: Ketika telah dekat waktu kelahiran Ahmad ﷺ dari izin-Nya, yang apabila menghendaki sesuatu pasti terwujud.
passages.en: When the time of Ahmad's birth ﷺ drew near, by His leave — He who, when He wills a thing, it surely comes to be.

passages.sub: Part IV: When the Time Drew Near…
passages.ar: حَمَلَتْ بِهِ الْأُمُّ الْأَمِينَةُ بِنْـتُ وَهْــ ۞ ــــبٍ مَنْ لَهَا أَعْلَى الْإِلٰـهُ مَكَانَـا
passages.tr: ḫamalat bihil-ummul-amînatu bintu wah- ۞bin man lahâ a‘lal-ilâhi makânâ
passages.id_: Ia ﷺ berada di dalam kandungan sang ibu Aminah binti Wahb, seseorang Allah muliakan kedudukannya.
passages.en: He ﷺ was in the womb of the mother, Aminah bint Wahb, one whose rank Allah honoured.

passages.sub: Part IV: When the Time Drew Near…
passages.ar: مِنْ وَالِـدِ الْمُخْتَـارِ عَبْـدِ اللهِ بـْنِ ۞ عَبْـدٍ لِمُطَّـلِـبٍ رَأَى الْبُرْهَـانَـا
passages.tr: Min wâlidil-mukhtâri ‘abdillâḫib-ni ۞ ‘abdil-mutahallibin ra'al-burhânâ
passages.id_: Dari ayah sang hamba yang terpilih ﷺ, yaitu (ayahnya itu) Abdullah bin Abdul Muthalib yang melihat tanda-tanda (isyarat kenabian).
passages.en: From the father of the chosen servant ﷺ, namely (his father) Abdullah ibn Abdul Muttalib, who saw the signs (hints of prophethood).

passages.sub: Part IV: When the Time Drew Near…
passages.ar: قَدْ كَانَ يَغْمُـرُ نُـورُ طَـهَ وَجْهَـهُ ۞ وَسَرَى إِلَى الْابْنِ الْمَصُـوْنِ عَيَانَـا
passages.tr: Qad kânâ yaghmuru nûru thaha wajhahu ۞ wa sarâ ilal-ibnil-mashûni ‘ayânâ
passages.id_: Wajah sang ayah semula diliputi terang cahaya Thâhâ ﷺ, yang kemudian cahaya itu berpindah kepada sang anak yang dijaga.
passages.en: The father's face was first wrapped in the bright light of Ta-Ha ﷺ, which then passed to the guarded child.

passages.sub: Part IV: When the Time Drew Near…
passages.ar: وَهُوَ ابْنُ هَاشِمٍ الْكَرِيمِ الشَّهَـمِ بْـنِ ۞ عَبْـدِ مَنَـافِ بْـن قُصَيٍّ كَانَـا
passages.tr: Wa huwab-nu hâsyimil-karîmisy-syahamib-ni ۞ ‘abdi manâfib-ni qushayyin kânâ
passages.id_: Dia adalah keturunan Hasyim yang mulia dan perkasa, putra Abdu Manâf, keturunan qushay yang dahulu.
passages.en: He is of the descendants of the noble and mighty Hashim, son of Abdu Manaf, of the line of Qusayy of old.

passages.sub: Part IV: When the Time Drew Near…
passages.ar: وَالِـدُهُ يُدْعَى حَكِيـمًــــا شَــــأْنُـهُ ۞ قَـدِ اعْتَلَى أَعْـزِزْ بِذٰلِكَ شَانَـا
passages.tr: Wâliduhu yud‘â ḫakîman sya'nuhu ۞ qadi’-talâ a‘ziz bidzâlika syânâ
passages.id_: Ayahnya digelari hakîm (orang yang adil). Kepribadiannya luhur. Muliakanlah (beliau) atas dasar kepribadian itu!
passages.en: His father was titled 'hakim' (a just man). His character was lofty. So honour (him) on the basis of that character!

passages.sub: Part IV: When the Time Drew Near…
passages.ar: وَاحْفَظْ أُصُولَ الْمُصْطَفَى حَتَّى تَرَى ۞ فِيْ سِلْسِـلَاتِ أُصُولِـهِ عَدْنَانَـا
passages.tr: Waḫfadh ushûlal-mushthafâ ḫatâ tarâ ۞ fî silsilâti ushûlihi ‘adnânâ
passages.id_: Hafalkanlah silsilah keturunan sang nabi terpilih ﷺ hingga kautemukan silisilahnya berakar pada (datuknya) Adnan.
passages.en: Memorize the lineage of the chosen Prophet ﷺ until you find his line rooted in (his forefather) Adnan.

passages.sub: Part IV: When the Time Drew Near…
passages.ar: فَهُنَاكَ قِفْ وَاعْلَمْ بِرَفْعِهِ إِِلَى إِسْــ ۞ ـمَاعِيـلَ كَـانَ لِلْأَبِ مِعْـوَانَـا
passages.tr: Fahunâka qif wa‘lam biraf‘ihi ilâ is-۞ mâ‘îla kânâ lil-abi mi‘wânâ
passages.id_: Bila silsilah telah sampai kepada Adnan, berhentilah! Ketahuilah bahwa nasabnya bersambung hingga Nabi Ismail as yang telah menjadi pendukung ayahnya (Ibrahim as).
passages.en: When the line reaches Adnan, stop! Know that his lineage joins up to Prophet Isma'il, upon him be peace, who became the supporter of his father (Ibrahim, upon him be peace).

passages.sub: Part IV: When the Time Drew Near…
passages.ar: وَحِيْنَمَا حَمَـلَـتْ بِــهِ اٰمِنَــــةٌ ۞ لَـمْ تَشْـكُ شَيْئًا يأْخُـذُ النِّسْوَانَـا
passages.tr: Wa ḫînamâ ḫamalat bihi âminatun ۞ lam tasyku syai'an ya'khudzun-niswânâ
passages.id_: Kala mengandungnya, Sayyidah Aminah ra tidak mengeluh sebagaimana perempuan hamil pada umumnya.
passages.en: While carrying him, Lady Aminah (may Allah be pleased with her) did not complain as pregnant women commonly do.

passages.sub: Part IV: When the Time Drew Near…
passages.ar: وَبِهَا أَحَاطَ اللُّطْفُ مِـنْ رَبِّ السَّمَا ۞ أَقْصَى الْأَذَى والْهَـمَّ والْأَحْزَانَـا
passages.tr: Wa bihâ aḫâthal-luthfu min rabbis-samâ ۞ aqshal-adzâ walhamma wal-aḫzânâ
passages.id_: Selubung kelembutan dari Allah pemelihara langit yang meliputi Sayyidah Aminah melenyapkan segala rasa sakit, kegelisahan, dan kesedihan.
passages.en: A veil of gentleness from Allah, Guardian of the heavens, that enveloped Lady Aminah, swept away every pain, anxiety, and sorrow.

passages.sub: Part IV: When the Time Drew Near…
passages.ar: وَرَأَتْ كَمَا قَدْ جَاءَ مَا عَلِمَـتْ بِـهِ ۞ أَنَّ الْمُهَيْمِنَ شَــرَّفَ الْأَكْـوَانَـا
passages.tr: Wa ra'at kamâ qad jâ'a mâ‘alimaat bihi ۞ annal-muhaimina syarrafal-akwânâ
passages.id_: Kemudian Sayyidah Aminah menyaksikan, sebagaimana telah tiba sesuatu yang diketahuinya, bahwa yang Maha Pemelihara telah memuliakan alam semesta.
passages.en: Then Lady Aminah witnessed, as that which she knew came to pass, that the All-Preserving had honoured the universe.

passages.sub: Part IV: When the Time Drew Near…
passages.ar: بِالطُّهْرِ مَنْ فِي بَطْنِهَـا فَاسْتَبْشَـرَتْ ۞ وَدَنَا الْمَخَاضُ فَأُتْرِعَتْ رِضْوَانَا
passages.tr: Bith-thuhri man fî bathnihâ fastabsyarat ۞ wa danal-makhâdlu fa'utri‘at ridlwânâ
passages.id_: Dengan kesucian bayi di dalam kandungannya, ia pun bergembira ketika telah dekat saat-saat kelahiran, hingga meluap-luaplah keridhaannya.
passages.en: By the purity of the infant in her womb, she rejoiced as the moments of birth drew near, until her contentment overflowed.

passages.sub: Part IV: When the Time Drew Near…
passages.ar: (سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَالْحَـمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَلآ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ ×٤، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ فِي كُلِّ لَحْظَةٍ أَبَدًا عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِهِ وَزِيْنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ)
passages.tr: (Subḫânallâhi wal-ḫamdulillâhi wa lâ ilâha illallâhu wallâhu akbaru 4x, wa lâ ḫaula wa lâ quwwata illâ billâhil-‘aliyyil-‘adhîmi fî kulli laḫdhatin abadan ‘adada khalqihi wa ridlâ'a nafsihi wa zînata ‘arsyihi wa midâda kalimatihi)
passages.id_: [Membaca tasbih, tahmid, tahlil, takbir, 4x, lalu hauqalah]. (Mahasuci Allah, segala puji bagi Allah, tiada Tuhan selain Allah, Allah Mahabesar. Tiada daya dan upaya kecuali dengan pertolongan Allah yang Mahatinggi, lagi Mahaagung sebanyak bilangan ciptaannya, dan seluas keridhaannya, dan seberat timbangan arsynya dan juga sebanyak tinta yang digunakan untuk menulis kalimatnya).
passages.en: [Recite tasbih, tahmid, tahlil, takbir four times, then hawqalah]. (Glory be to Allah, all praise is due to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is Most Great. There is no might nor power save by Allah the Most High, the Most Magnificent — as many as the number of His creatures, as vast as His pleasure, as heavy as the weight of His Throne, and as much as the ink used to write His words.)

passages.sub: Part IV: When the Time Drew Near…
passages.ar: وتَجَــــلَّتِ الْأَنْـوَارُ مِنْ كُلِّ الْجِهَـــــا ۞ تِ فَوَقْـتُ مِيـْلَادِ الْمُشَفَّـعِ حَانَـا
passages.tr: Wa tajallatil-anwâru min kullil-jihâ- ۞ ti fawaqtu mîlâdil-musyaffa‘i ḫânâ
passages.id_: Maka muncullah cahaya-cahaya dari segala penjuru dan detik kelahiran sosok yang diharapkan syafaatnya itu pun tiba.
passages.en: Then lights appeared from every quarter, and the very instant of the birth of the one whose intercession is hoped for arrived.

passages.sub: Part IV: When the Time Drew Near…
passages.ar: وَقُبَيْلَ فَجْرٍ أَبْرَزَتْ شَمْـسَ الْهُـدَى ۞ ظَهَرَ الْحَبِيْبُ مُكَرَّمًا وَمُصَانَـا
passages.tr: Wa qubaila fajrin abrazat syamsal-hudâ ۞ dhaharal-ḫabîbu mukarraman wa mushânâ
passages.id_: Beberapa saat sebelum terbitnya fajar muncullah matahari hidayah, lahirlah sang kekasih yang dimuliakan dan dijaga.
passages.en: Moments before the break of dawn, the sun of guidance rose; the beloved, honoured and guarded, was born.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: ﴿مَحَـــلُّ الْقِيَــــامِ﴾
passages.tr: ﴾maḫalul-qiyâmi﴿
passages.id_: (Saatnya berdiri)
passages.en: (Time to stand)

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّـدْ ۞ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ×٣
passages.tr: Shallallâḫu ‘alâ muḫammad ۞ shallallâhu ‘alaihi wa sallam 3x
passages.id_: Semoga Allah melimpahkan rahmat kepada (Nabi) Muhammad. Semoga Allah melimpahkan rahmat dan keselamatan kepada (Nabi) Muhammad.
passages.en: May Allah pour mercy upon (Prophet) Muhammad. May Allah pour mercy and peace upon (Prophet) Muhammad.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: يَا نَبِيْ سَــلَامْ عَلَيْكَ ۞ يَا رَسُوْلْ سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ
passages.tr: Yâ nabî salâmu ‘alaika ۞ yâ rasûl salâm ‘alaika
passages.id_: Wahai Nabi ﷺ keselamatan bagimu, wahai rasul keselamatan bagimu.
passages.en: O Prophet ﷺ, peace be upon you; O Messenger, peace be upon you.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: يَا حَبِيْبْ سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ ۞ صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ عَلَيْكَ
passages.tr: Yâ ḫabîb salâm ‘alaika ۞ yâ rasûl salâm ‘alaika
passages.id_: Wahai kekasih keselamatan bagimu, shalawat Allah bagimu.
passages.en: O beloved, peace be upon you; the blessings of Allah be upon you.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: أَبْرَزَ اللهُ الْمُشَــــفَّعْ ۞ صَاحِبَ الْقَدْرِ الْمُرَفَّعْ
passages.tr: Abrazallâhul-musyaffa‘ ۞shâḫibal-qadril-muraffa’
passages.id_: Allah telah mendatangkan (ke dunia) nabi yang diharapkan syafaat, yang memiliki derajat yang dimuliakan.
passages.en: Allah has brought (into the world) the Prophet whose intercession is hoped for, possessor of an honoured rank.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: فَمَلَا النُّوْرُ النَّوَاحِيْ ۞ عَمَّ كُلَّ الْكَوْنِ أَجْمَعْ
passages.tr: Famalan-nûrun-nawâḫî ۞ ‘amma kullal-kauni ajma’
passages.id_: Semburat cahaya memenuhi segala penjuru, meliputi seluruh alam semesta.
passages.en: A burst of light filled every quarter, enveloping the whole universe.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: نُكِّسَتْ أَصْنَامُ شِرْكٍ ۞ وَبِنَا الشِّرْكِ تَصَدَّعْ
passages.tr: Nukkisat ashnâmu syirkin ۞ wa binasy-syirki tashadda’
passages.id_: Patung-patung berhala di Ka’bah pun dijungkirkan, dan bangunan kemusyrikan pun retak.
passages.en: The idols in the Ka'bah were toppled, and the edifices of idolatry cracked.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: وَدَنَا وَقْتُ الْهِـــدَايَةْ ۞ وَحِمَى الْكُفْرِ تَزَعْزَعْ
passages.tr: Wa danâ waqtul-hidâyah ۞ wa ḫimal-kufri taza‘za‘
passages.id_: Saat-saat datangnya petunjuk kian dekat, dan benteng kekafiran pun berguncang.
passages.en: The moments of guidance's coming drew nearer, and the fortress of disbelief shook.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: مَرْحَبًا أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا ۞ بِكَ يَا ذَا الْقَدْرِ الْأَرْفَعْ
passages.tr: Marḫaban ahlan wa sahlan ۞ bika yâ dzal-qadril-arfa‘
passages.id_: Selamat datang, wahai sang pemilik derajat yang mulia.
passages.en: Welcome, O possessor of the noble rank.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: يَا إِمَامَ أَهْلِ الرِّسَالَةْ ۞ مَنْ بِهِ الْآفَاتُ تُدْفَعْ
passages.tr: Yâ imâma ahlir-risâlah ۞ man bihil-afâtu tudfa‘
passages.id_: Wahai imam dan pemimpin para rasul, yang dengannya ﷺ bencana-bencana tertolakkan
passages.en: O imam and leader of the messengers, by whom ﷺ calamities are repelled.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: أَنْتَ فِي الْحَشْرِ مَلَاذٌ ۞ لَكَ كُلُّ الْخَلْقِ تَفْزَعْ
passages.tr: Anta fil-ḫusyri malâdzun ۞ laka kullul-khalqi tafza‘
passages.id_: Engkaulah tempat perlindungan di hari Kiamat, kepadamulah seluruh makhluk takut (tak mendapatkan syafaat).
passages.en: You are the place of refuge on the Day of Resurrection; to you all creatures turn in fear (of not attaining intercession).

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: وَيُنَادُوْنَ تَرَى مَا ۞ قَدْ دَهَى مِنْ هَوْلٍ أَفْظَعْ
passages.tr: Wa yunâdûna tarâ mâ ۞ qad dahâ min haulin afdha‘
passages.id_: Kemudian mereka datang memanggil-manggil, ketika menyaksikan dahsyatnya kepanikan dan kegentingan.
passages.en: Then they come calling out, when they witness the terror of the panic and dire distress.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: مَرْحَبًا يَا نُوْرَ عَيْنِي (مَرْحَبًا) ۞ مَرْحَبًا جَدَّ الْحُسَيْنِ (مَرْحَبًا)
passages.tr: Marḫaban yâ nûra ‘aini (marḫaban) ۞ marḫaban jaddal-ḫusaini (marḫaban)
passages.id_: Selamat datang wahai cahaya mataku, selamat datang wahai kakek dari Sayyidina Husain
passages.en: Welcome, O light of my eye; welcome, O grandfather of our master Husain.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: فَلَهَا أَنْتَ فَتَسْجُدْ ۞ وَتُنَادَى اشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ
passages.tr: Falahâ anta fatasjud ۞ wa tunâdâsy-fa‘ tusyaffa‘
passages.id_: Untuk mereka engkau bersujud (kepada Allah). Mereka memanggil-manggil minta syafaat (pertolongan), engkau pun menolongnya.
passages.en: For them you prostrate (to Allah). They call out pleading for intercession (help), and you aid them.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: فَعَلْيْكَ اللهُ صَلَّى ۞ مَا بَدَا النُّوْرُ وَشَعْشَعْ
passages.tr: Fa‘alaikallâhu shallâ ۞ mâ badan-nûru wa sya‘sya‘
passages.id_: Semoga limpahan rahmat dari Allah tercurah kepadamu, selama cahaya bersinar dan pancarannya menyebar ke mana-mana.
passages.en: May the outpouring of Allah's mercy be poured upon you, as long as light shines and its radiance spreads everywhere.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: وَبِكَ الرَّحْمٰنَ نَسْأَلْ ۞ وَإِلٰهُ الْعَرْشِ يَسْمَعْ
passages.tr: Wa bikar-raḫmâna nas'al ۞ wa ilâhul-‘arsyi yasma‘
passages.id_: Melalui dirimu (wahai Nabi ﷺ), kami memohon pada Allah ar-Rahman, maka pencipta arsy mendengar doa kami.
passages.en: Through you (O Prophet ﷺ), we beseech Allah, ar-Rahman, and so the Creator of the Throne hears our prayer.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: رَبَّ فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوْبِي (يَا اَلله) ۞ بِبَرْكَةِ الْهَادِي الْمُشَفَّعْ (يَا اَلله)
passages.tr: Rabbi faghfir lî dzunûbî (ya Allâh) ۞ bibarkatil-hâdil-musyaffa‘ (yâ Allâh)
passages.id_: Ya Allah, ampunilah dosa-dosaku melalui perantara keberkahan sang penuntun yang diharapkan syafaatnya ﷺ.
passages.en: O Allah, forgive my sins through the blessing of the guide whose intercession is hoped for ﷺ.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: يَا عَظِيْمَ الْمَنِّ يَا رَبْ ۞ شَمْلَنَا بِالْمُصْطَفَى اجْمَعْ
passages.tr: Yâ ‘adhîmal-manni yâ rab ۞ syamlanâ bil-mushthafaj-ma‘
passages.id_: Wahai Maha Pemberi anugerah wahai Rabb, kumpulkanlah golongan kami dengan al-Musthafa ﷺ (sang nabi terpilih).
passages.en: O Bestower of grace, O Lord, gather our company with al-Mustafa ﷺ (the chosen Prophet).

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: وَبِـــهِ فَــــانْظُرْ إِلَيْنَــــا ۞ وَاعْطِنَا بِهِ كُلَّ مَطْمَعْ
passages.tr: Wa bihi fandhur ilainâ ۞ wa‘thinâ bihi kulla muth‘am
passages.id_: Berkat beliau ﷺ, pandangilah kami dengan kasih sayang-Mu dan kami berkat beliau ﷺ, berilah segala yang kami inginkan.
passages.en: For his sake ﷺ, look upon us with Your compassion, and for his sake ﷺ, grant us all that we desire.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: وَاكْفِنَا كُلَّ الْبَـــلَايَا ۞ وَادْفَعِ الْآفَاتِ وَارْفَعْ
passages.tr: Wakfinâ kullal-balâyâ ۞ wadfa‘il-âfâti warfa‘
passages.id_: Hindarkanlah kami dari segala bencana, dan cegahlah segala kesengsaraan, dan angkatlah sejauh-jauhnya.
passages.en: Shield us from every calamity, ward off every misery, and lift it far, far away.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: (صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى مَحُمَّد) ۞ (صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّم)
passages.tr: (shallallâhu ‘alâ muḫammad) ۞ (shallallâhu ‘alaihi wa sallam)
passages.id_: Semoga Allah melimpahkan rahmat kepada Nabi Muhammad ﷺ. Semoga Allah melimpahkan rahmat dan keselamatan kepada beliau ﷺ.
passages.en: May Allah pour mercy upon Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. May Allah pour mercy and peace upon him ﷺ.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: وَاسْقِنَا يَا رَبْ أَغِثْنَا ۞ بِحَيًا هَطَّالْ يَهْمَعْ
passages.tr: Wasqinâ yâ rabb aghitsnâ ۞ biḫayyan haththal yahma‘
passages.id_: Ya Rabb, siramilah kami (dengan rahmatmu). Tolonglah kami dengan kehidupan yang dicurahi lebatnya hujan kasih sayang-Mu.
passages.en: O Lord, water us (with Your mercy). Aid us with a life showered by the heavy rains of Your compassion.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: وَاخْتِمِ الْعُمْـرَ بِحُسْنَى ۞ وَاحْسِنِ الْعُقْبَى وَمَرْجَعْ
passages.tr: Wakhtimil-‘umra biḫusnâ ۞ waḫsinil-‘uqbâ wa marja‘
passages.id_: Akhirilah usia kami dengan husnul khatimah dan perbaguslah kehidupan akhirat dan saat kami kembali kepada-Mu.
passages.en: End our lives with a good ending (husnul khatimah), and make beautiful the life of the Hereafter and the time of our return to You.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: وَصَـــــلَاةُ اللهِ تَغْشَى ۞ مَنْ لَهُ الْحُسْنُ تَجَمَّعْ
passages.tr: Wa shalâtullâḫi taghsyâ ۞ man lahul-ḫusnu tajamma‘
passages.id_: Semoga rahmat Allah menyelubungi orang yang memiliki segala kumpulan kebaikan dalam dirinya.
passages.en: May the mercy of Allah envelop the one who holds within himself every gathering of goodness.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: أَحْمَــــدَ الطُّهْـــــرَ وَآلِه ۞ وَالصَّحَابَةْ مَا السَّنَا شَعْ
passages.tr: Aḫmadath-thuhra wa âlih ۞ wash-shaḫâbat mas-sanâ sya‘
passages.id_: Dialah Ahmad ﷺ yang suci. Begitu juga, semoga menyelubungi keluarganya serta para sahabatnya dengan rahmat yang selalu bercahaya terang benderang.
passages.en: He is Ahmad ﷺ, the pure. Likewise, may it envelop his family and his companions with a mercy ever shining bright.

passages.sub: Standing (Mahallul Qiyam) — adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: ﴿اَللّٰهمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وعَلَى اٰلِهِ﴾
passages.tr: ﴾Allâhumma shalli wa sallim wa bârik ‘alaihi wa ‘ala âlihi﴿
passages.id_: Ya Allah limpahkanlah rahmat keagungan, keselamatan, serta keberkahan kepada Nabi dan keluarganya.
passages.en: O Allah, pour the mercy of majesty, peace, and blessing upon the Prophet and his family.

passages.sub: Part V: The Beloved Was Born…
passages.ar: وُلِدَ الْحَبِيْبُ فَخَرَّ حَالًا سَاجِدًا ۞ لِلّٰهِ مَنْ أَنْشَأَنَا وَبَرَانَا
passages.tr: Wulidal-ḫabîbu fakharra ḫâlan sâjidan ۞ lillâhi man ansya'anâ wa barânâ
passages.id_: Ketika sang kekasih ﷺ lahir, beliau ﷺ tertunduk dalam kondisi bersujud kepada Allah yang telah menghidupkan serta menciptakan kita.
passages.en: When the beloved ﷺ was born, he ﷺ bowed low in prostration to Allah, who gave us life and created us.

passages.sub: Part V: The Beloved Was Born…
passages.ar: وَرِعَايَةُ الْمَوْلَى تُحِيْطُ بِأَحْمَدَ ۞ فِيْ كُلِّ حِيْنٍ بَاطِنًا وَعَيَانَا
passages.tr: Wa ri‘âyatul-maulâ tuḫithu bi aḫmada ۞ fî kulli ḫînin bâthinan wa ‘ayâna
passages.id_: Dan bimbingan sang pencipta selalu menaungi Ahmad ﷺ setiap waktu, secara tersembunyi dan terlihat kasat mata.
passages.en: And the guidance of the Creator ever sheltered Ahmad ﷺ at all times, both hidden and plainly seen.

passages.sub: Part V: The Beloved Was Born…
passages.ar: قَدْ أَرْضَعَتْهُ الْأُمُّ ثُمَّ ثُوَيْبَــــةٌ ۞ وَحَلِيْمَةٌ مَنْ سُعْدُهَا قَدْ بَانَا
passages.tr: Qad ardla‘athul-ummu tsumma tsuwaibatun ۞ wa ḫalîmatun man su‘duhâ qad bânâ
passages.id_: Beliau ﷺ disusui oleh ibunya dan diteruskan oleh Tsuwaibah ra kemudian Halimah ra yang telah jelas kebahagiaannya.
passages.en: He ﷺ was nursed by his mother, then by Thuwaibah (may Allah be pleased with her), then by Halimah (may Allah be pleased with her), whose happiness was made plain.

passages.sub: Part V: The Beloved Was Born…
passages.ar: قَدْ بَشَّرَتْ ثُوَيْبَةٌ سَيِّدَهَـــــا ۞ أَبَا لَهَبٍ أَعْتَقَهَا فَرْحَانَا
passages.tr: Qad basysyarat tsuwaibatun sayyidahâ ۞ abâ lahabin a‘taqahâ farḫânâ
passages.id_: Ketika Tsuwaibah menyampaikan berita kepada tuannya (tentang kelahiran Muhammad), Abu Lahab memerdekakannya sebagai tanda sukacita.
passages.en: When Thuwaibah brought the news to her master (of Muhammad's birth), Abu Lahab freed her as a token of joy.

passages.sub: Part V: The Beloved Was Born…
passages.ar: لَمْ يَنْسَ خَالِقُنَا لَهُ فَرْحَتَـــهُ ۞ بِالْمُصْطَفَى وَبِذَا الْحَدِيْثُ أَتَانَا
passages.tr: Lam yansa khâliqunâ lahu farḫatahu ۞ bil-mushthafâ wa bidzâl-ḫaditsu atânâ
passages.id_: Tidaklah Tuhan yang Maha Pencipta lupa atas kesukacitaannya (Abu Lahab) dengan kelahiran al-Musthafa ﷺ, sebagaimana tercantum dalam hadits (riwayat Abbas bin Abdul Muthalib ra, di Shahih Bukhari).
passages.en: The Creator did not forget his (Abu Lahab's) joy at the birth of al-Mustafa ﷺ, as recorded in the hadith (narrated by Abbas ibn Abdul Muttalib, may Allah be pleased with him, in Sahih al-Bukhari).

passages.sub: Part V: The Beloved Was Born…
passages.ar: أَنَّ الْعَــذَابَ مُخَفَّفٌ فِيْ كُلِّ إثْـــ ۞ ـــنَيْنِ لِفَرْحَتِهِ بِمَنْ وَافَانَا
passages.tr: Annal-‘adzâba mukhaffafun fî kulli its- ۞ naini lifarḫatihi biman wâfânâ
passages.id_: Bahwa siksaan Abu Lahab diringankan pada setiap hari Senin lantaran kegembiraannya atas (kelahiran) orang yang telah menunaikan kewajibannya kepada kita.
passages.en: That Abu Lahab's torment is lightened every Monday because of his joy at (the birth of) the one who fulfilled his duty to us.

passages.sub: Part V: The Beloved Was Born…
passages.ar: هٰذَا مَعَ الْكُفْرِ فَكَيْفَ بِفَرْحَةٍ ۞ مِنْ ذِيْ فُؤَادٍ امْتَلَا إِيْمَانَا
passages.tr: Hâdzâ ma‘al-kufri fakaifa bifarḫatin ۞ min dzî fu'âdin imtalâ îmâna
passages.id_: Demikianlah rahmat Allah terhadap orang kafir. Tak terbayangkan (anugerah) ketika kegembiraan itu muncul dari seorang mukmin yang hatinya dipenuhi keimanan.
passages.en: Such is the mercy of Allah toward a disbeliever. Unimaginable then (is the grace) when that joy comes from a believer whose heart is filled with faith.

passages.sub: Part V: The Beloved Was Born…
passages.ar: وَرَأَتْ حَلِيْمَةُ مَا قَدْ رَأَتْ مِنْ بَرَكَا ۞ تِ مُحَمَّدٍ مَا حَيَّرَ الْأَذْهَانَا
passages.tr: Wa ra'at ḫalîmatu mâ qad ra'at min barakâ- ۞ ti muḫammadin mâ ḫayyaral-adzhânâ
passages.id_: Halimah ra menyaksikan sedemikian banyak keberkahan Muhammad ﷺ yang mencengangkan pikiran.
passages.en: Halimah (may Allah be pleased with her) witnessed so many blessings of Muhammad ﷺ that stunned the mind.

passages.sub: Part V: The Beloved Was Born…
passages.ar: دَرَّ لَهُ الثَّدْيُ وَقَدْ كَانَ ابْنُهَا ۞ يَبِيْتُ يَبْكِيْ مُسْغَبًا جَيْعَانَا
passages.tr: Darra lahuts-tsadyu wa qad kânab-nuhâ ۞ yabîtu yabkî musghaban jai‘ânâ
passages.id_: Di antaranya, air susu Halimah ra mengalir padahal sebelumnya anaknya sendiri pun pada malam hari menangis terus karena lapar (lantaran air susu Halimah tak keluar sama sekali sebab ia juga kelaparan).
passages.en: Among them, Halimah's milk flowed (freely), though before, even her own child had wept all night from hunger (because Halimah's milk had not come at all, for she too was starving).

passages.sub: Part V: The Beloved Was Born…
passages.ar: لَكِنَّهُ لَيْلَةَ أَنْ جَــاءَ الْحَبِيْــــ ۞ ـبُ بَاتَ مَوْفُوْرَ الرِّضَا شَبْعَانَا
passages.tr: Lakinnahu lailata an jâ`al-ḫabî- ۞ bu bâta maufûrar-ridlâ syab’ânâ
passages.id_: Akan tetapi malam itu, sejak kedatangan sang kekasih ﷺ, putra kandung Halimah ra tidur pulas dan kenyang (karena air susunya mengalir dengan derasnya).
passages.en: But that night, from the coming of the beloved ﷺ, Halimah's own son slept soundly and full (for her milk flowed abundantly).

passages.sub: Part V: The Beloved Was Born…
passages.ar: وَدَرَّتِ النَّاقَةُ أَلْبَانًـــــا وَقَدْ ۞ سَمُنَتْ دُوَيْبَتُهَا فَكَانَ شَانَا
passages.tr: Wa darratin-nâqatu albânan wa qad ۞ sanumat duwaibatuhâ fakâna syânâ
passages.id_: Dan mengalir pulalah air susu untanya, lalu binatang menjadi gemuk dan sehat.
passages.en: The milk of her camel flowed too, and the animal grew fat and healthy.

passages.sub: Part V: The Beloved Was Born…
passages.ar: أَنْكَرَهُ رِفْقَتُـهَـــــا وَسَــــلَّمَتْ ۞ أَشْجَارٌ أَحْجَارٌ عَلَى مَوْلَانَا
passages.tr: Ankarahu rifqatuhâ wa sallamat ۞ asyjârun aḫjârun ‘alâ maulânâ
passages.id_: Hal ini membingungkan teman-teman yang bersamanya (Halimah ra). Pemohonan dan bebatuan pun memberi salam kepada pemimpin kita ﷺ.
passages.en: This bewildered the companions who were with her (Halimah). The trees and the stones gave greeting to our leader ﷺ.

passages.sub: Part V: The Beloved Was Born…
passages.ar: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ أَنْطَـقَ أَشْجَارًا وَأَحْـــ ۞ ـجَارًا تُحَيِّي الْمُصْطَفَى سُبْحَانَا
passages.tr: Subḫâna man athlaqa asyjâran wa aḫ- ۞ jâran tuḫayyil-mushthafâ subḫâna
passages.id_: Mahasuci Allah yang telah membuat pepohonan dan bebatuan berbicara, sebagia penghormatan kepada sang terpilih ﷺ. Mahasucilah Dia ﷻ.
passages.en: Glory be to Allah, who made the trees and stones speak, in honour of the chosen one ﷺ. Glorified be He.

passages.sub: Part V: The Beloved Was Born…
passages.ar: يَا رَبَّنَا صَــلِّ وَسَلِّمْ دَائِمًــــــا ۞ عَلَى حَبِيْبِكَ مَنْ إِلَيْكَ دَعَانَا
passages.tr: Ya rabbanaâ shalli wa sallim dâ`iman ۞ ‘alâ ḫabîbika man ilaika da’ânâ
passages.id_: Wahai Tuhan kami, limpahkanlah rahmat dan keselamatan selamanya pada kekasih-Mu yang telah menyeru kami kepada-Mu.
passages.en: O our Lord, pour mercy and peace forever upon Your beloved who called us to You.

passages.sub: Part V: The Beloved Was Born…
passages.ar: ﴿اَللّٰهمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وعَلَى اٰلِهِ﴾
passages.tr: ﴾Allâhumma shalli wa sallim wa bârik ‘alaihi wa ‘ala âlihi﴿
passages.id_: Ya Allah limpahkanlah rahmat keagungan, keselamatan, serta keberkahan kepada Nabi dan keluarganya.
passages.en: O Allah, pour the mercy of majesty, peace, and blessing upon the Prophet and his family.

passages.sub: Part VI: Thus, and He Grew Up…
passages.ar: هٰذَا وَقَدْ نَشَأَ الْحَبِيْبُ بِسِيْرَةٍ ۞ مَرْضِيَّةٍ وَمَا أَتَى عِصْيَانَا
passages.tr: Hâdzâ wa qad nasya'al-ḫabîbu bisîratin ۞ mardliyyatin wa mâ atâ ‘ishyânâ
passages.id_: Sang kekasih ﷺ tumbuh dewasa dalam rentang sejarah yang penuh keridhaan. Tidaklah beliau ﷺ berbuat maksiat sama sekali.
passages.en: The beloved ﷺ grew up over a span of history full of grace. He ﷺ never committed a single sin.

passages.sub: Part VI: Thus, and He Grew Up…
passages.ar: تَرْعَــــاهُ عَيْنُ اللهِ مَنْ أَدَّبَــــهُ ۞ أَحْسَنَ تَأْدِيْبَ النَّبِيِّ إِحْسَانَا
passages.tr: Tar‘âhu ‘ainullâhi man addabahu ۞ aḫsana ta'dîban-nabiyyi iḫsânâ
passages.id_: Nabi ﷺ hidup dalam bimbinga Allah yang telah mendidik budi pekerti beliau ﷺ dengan sebaik-baik budi pekerti kenabian.
passages.en: The Prophet ﷺ lived under the guidance of Allah, who trained his character ﷺ with the finest of prophetic character.

passages.sub: Part VI: Thus, and He Grew Up…
passages.ar: فَنَشَا صَدُوْقًا مُحْسِنًا ذَا عِفَّةٍ ۞ وَفُتُوَّةٍ وَأَمَانَةٍ مِعْوَانَا
passages.tr: Fanasyâ shadûqan muḫsinan dzâ ‘iffatin ۞ wa futuwwatin wa amânatin mi‘wânâ
passages.id_: Nabi ﷺ tumbuh sebagai pribadi yang amat jujur, gemar berbuat baik, mampu mengendalikan diri, dermawan, amanah, suka menolong.
passages.en: The Prophet ﷺ grew up as one exceedingly truthful, fond of doing good, self-controlled, generous, trustworthy, and eager to help.

passages.sub: Part VI: Thus, and He Grew Up…
passages.ar: ذَا هِمَّــــةٍ وَشَجَــــاعَـةٍ وَتَوَقُّــــرٍ ۞ وَمَكَارِمٍ لَا تَحْتَصِي حُسْبَانَا
passages.tr: Dzâ himmatin wa syajâ‘atin wa tawaqqurin ۞ wa makârimin lâ taḫtashî ḫusbânâ
passages.id_: Pemilik semangat, keberanian, ketenangan, serta segala bentuk sifat mulia yang tak terhitung banyaknya.
passages.en: Possessor of zeal, courage, calm, and every form of noble trait beyond counting.

passages.sub: Part VI: Thus, and He Grew Up…
passages.ar: دُعِيَ الْأَمِيْنُ وَهُوَ فِيْ أَهْلِ السَّمَا ۞ نِعْمَ الْأَمِيْنُ لَهُ الْمُهَيْمِنُ صَانَا
passages.tr: Du‘iyal-amînu wa huwa fî ahlis-samâ ۞ ni‘mal-amînu lahul-muhaiminu shânâ
passages.id_: Beliau ﷺ digelari “al-amin” (yang tidak pernah berbohong) dan bagi penduduk langit ia beliau adalah ni'mal amîn (sebaik-baik orang yang tidak pernah berbohong). Yang Maha Memelihara senantiasa melindunginya.
passages.en: He ﷺ was titled 'al-Amin' (the one who never lies), and to the dwellers of heaven he is ni'mal amin (the best of the truthful). The All-Preserving ever protected him.

passages.sub: Part VI: Thus, and He Grew Up…
passages.ar: ذَهَبَتْ بِـــــهِ الْأُمُّ تَزُوْرُ أَبَـــــاهُ فِيْ ۞ طَيْبَةَ إِذْ فِيْهَا الْحِمَامُ كَانَا
passages.tr: Dzahabat bihil-ummu tazûru abâhu fî ۞ thaibata idz fîhâl-ḫimâmu kânâ
passages.id_: Ibunda Nabi ﷺ membawanya berziarah ke makam ayah beliau ﷺ (Sayyid Abdullah) di Thaibah (Madinah) karena di sanalah sang ayah wafat.
passages.en: The Prophet's mother ﷺ took him to visit the grave of his father ﷺ (Sayyid Abdullah) in Thaybah (Madinah), for it was there his father died.

passages.sub: Part VI: Thus, and He Grew Up…
passages.ar: وَالْمُصْطَفَى فِيْ بَطْنِـهَـــــا وَقَدْ أَتَى ۞ عَلَيْهِ سِتٌّ مِنْ سِنِيْهِ الْآنَا
passages.tr: Wal-mushthafâ fî bathnihâ wa qad atâ ۞ ‘alaihi sittun min sinîhil-ânâ
passages.id_: Nabi pilihan (saat sang ayah beliau wafat) masih dalam kandungan ibunya. Beliau mendatangi pusara sang ayah ketika usianya enam tahun.
passages.en: The chosen Prophet (at his father's death) was still in his mother's womb. He came to his father's grave at the age of six.

passages.sub: Part VI: Thus, and He Grew Up…
passages.ar: وَقَدْ أَتَاهَا الْمَوْتُ حِيْنَ رُجُوْعِهَا ۞ فَحَبَاهُ عَبْدُ الْمُطَّلِبِ حَنَانَا
passages.tr: Wa qad atâhal-mautu ḫîna rujû‘ihâ ۞ fahâbâhu ‘abdul-muthallibi ḫanânâ
passages.id_: Sang ibunda wafat dalam perjalanan pulang. Beliau ﷺ pun diasuh oleh Abdul Muthalib dengan penuh kasih sayang.
passages.en: His mother died on the journey home. He ﷺ was then raised by Abdul Muttalib with full tenderness.

passages.sub: Part VI: Thus, and He Grew Up…
passages.ar: سَنَتَيْنَ وَافَـــــاهُ الْحِمَـــــامُ فَضَمَّـــــهُ ۞ عَمٌّ مَلَا الْعَطْفُ عَلَيْهِ جَنَانَا
passages.tr: Sanataini wâfâhul-ḫimâmu fadlammahu ۞ ‘ammun malal-‘uthfu ‘alaihi janânâ
passages.id_: Dua tahun kemudian Abdul Muthalib pun wafat. Beliau ﷺ lalu diasuh pamannya, Abu Thalib, dengan penuh kelembutan.
passages.en: Two years later Abdul Muttalib died. He ﷺ was then raised by his uncle, Abu Talib, with full gentleness.

passages.sub: Part VI: Thus, and He Grew Up…
passages.ar: خَطَبَتْهُ بِنْتُ خُوَيْلِدٍ فِي الْخَمْسِ وَالْــ ۞ ــعِشْرِيْنَ حَازَتْ بِالْمُشَفَّعِ شَانَا
passages.tr: Khathabat hu bintu khuwailidin fil-khamsi wal- ۞ ‘isyrîna ḫâzat bil-musyaffa‘i syânâ
passages.id_: Beliau ﷺ dilamar oleh Sayyidah Khadijah binti Khuwailid saat beliau ﷺ berusia 25 tahun, karena ia (Khadijah) telah mendengar keajaiban-keajaiban pada diri sang pemberi syafaat ﷺ.
passages.en: He ﷺ was proposed to by Lady Khadijah bint Khuwailid when he ﷺ was 25 years old, for she (Khadijah) had heard of the marvels in the person of the intercessor ﷺ.

passages.sub: Part VI: Thus, and He Grew Up…
passages.ar: قَدْ حَقَّقَ الْمَوْلَى لَهَـــــا آمَـالَهَـــــــا ۞ نَالَتْ سَلَامًا عَالِيًا وَمَكَانَا
passages.tr: Qad ḫaqqaqal-maulâ lahâ âmâlahâ ۞ nâlat salâman ‘âliyan wa makânâ
passages.id_: Allah mengabulkan cita-citanya. Ia (Khadijah ra) pun mendapatkan kesejahteraan dan martabat yang mulia.
passages.en: Allah granted her aspiration. She (Khadijah, may Allah be pleased with her) attained well-being and a noble rank.

passages.sub: Part VI: Thus, and He Grew Up…
passages.ar: وَحَلَّ مُشْكِلَةً لِوَضْعِ الْحَجَـرِ الْــــ ۞ أَسْوَدِ في الْكَعْبَةِ حَيْثُ أَبَانَا
passages.tr: Wa ḫalla musykilatan liwad‘il-ḫajari al- ۞ aswadi fil-ka‘bati ḫaitsu abânâ
passages.id_: Kemudian beliau ﷺ menyelesaikan masalah (persengketaan kelompok) terkait peletakan Hajar Aswad setelah renovasi Ka'bah.
passages.en: Then he ﷺ resolved the dispute (between the clans) concerning the placing of the Black Stone after the renovation of the Ka'bah.

passages.sub: Part VI: Thus, and He Grew Up…
passages.ar: عَنْ سَعَةَ الْعَقْلِ وَوَقَّادِ الْحِجَـــا ۞ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ عَلَّمَهُ وَأَعَانَا
passages.tr: ‘an sa‘atal-‘aqli wa waqqâdil-ḫijâ ۞ subḫâna man ‘allamahu wa a‘ânâ
passages.id_: (Beliau mengurai konflik itu) dengan kejeniusan dan akal yang cemerlang. Mahasuci Allah yang telah mengajarinya dan menaunginya ﷺ.
passages.en: (He unravelled that conflict) with brilliance and a keen mind. Glory be to Allah, who taught him and sheltered him ﷺ.

passages.sub: Part VI: Thus, and He Grew Up…
passages.ar: يَا رَبَّنَــــا صَــــلِ وَسَــــلِّمْ دَائِمًـــــــا ۞ عَلَى حَبِيْبِكَ مَنْ إِلَيْكَ دَعَانَا
passages.tr: Yâ rabbanâ shalli wa sallim da'iman ۞ ‘alâ ḫabîbika man ilaika da‘ânâ
passages.id_: Wahai Tuhan kami, limpahkanlah rahmat dan keselamatan selamanya, pada kekasih-Mu yang telah menyeru kami kepada-Mu.
passages.en: O our Lord, pour mercy and peace forever upon Your beloved who called us to You.

passages.sub: Part VI: Thus, and He Grew Up…
passages.ar: ﴿اَللّٰهمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وعَلَى اٰلِهِ﴾
passages.tr: ﴾Allâhumma shalli wa sallim wa bârik ‘alaihi wa ‘ala âlihi﴿
passages.id_: Ya Allah limpahkanlah rahmat keagungan, keselamatan, serta keberkahan kepada Nabi dan keluarganya.
passages.en: O Allah, pour the mercy of majesty, peace, and blessing upon the Prophet and his family.

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: وَأَتَاهُ جِبْرِيْـــلُ بِوَحْيِ اللهِ فِيْ ۞ غَارِ حِرَاءِ يَعْبُدُ الرَّحْمٰنَ
passages.tr: Wa atâhu jibrîlu biwaḫyillâḫi fî ۞ ghâri ḫirâ'i ya‘budur-raḫmâna
passages.id_: Jibril as datang pada beliau ﷺ membawa wahyu Allah di gua Hira’ ketika beliau ﷺ beribadah kepada (Allah) ar-Rahman.
passages.en: Jibril, upon him be peace, came to him ﷺ bearing the revelation of Allah in the cave of Hira, while he ﷺ was worshipping (Allah) ar-Rahman.

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: وَضَمَّــــهُ الثَّـلَاثَ ثُمَّ أَرْسَلــَهُ ۞ اِقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ عَلَّمَ الْإِنْسَانَا
passages.tr: Wa dlammahuts-tsalâtsa tsumma arsalahu ۞ iqra wa rabbuka ‘allamal-insânâ
passages.id_: Jibril as memeluknya sebanyak tiga kali lalu melepaskannya, (dan berkata) bacalah demi Tuhanmu yang memberi ilmu pada manusia.
passages.en: Jibril, upon him be peace, embraced him three times, then released him, (saying) 'Read, by your Lord who gave knowledge to mankind.'

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: فَدَعَا ثَلَاثًا فِيْ خَفَا فَأَتَاهُ أَنْ ۞ اِصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرْ بِهِ إِعْلَانَا
passages.tr: Fada‘â tsalâtsan fî khafâ fa'atâhu an ۞ ishda‘ bimâ tu’mar bihi i‘lânâ
passages.id_: Lalu beliau ﷺ berdakwah dengan sembunyi-sembunyi selama tiga tahun hingga datangnya instruksi dari Allah “Sampaikanlah terang-terangan segala yang diperintahkan kepadamu”.
passages.en: Then he ﷺ called (to Islam) in secret for three years, until the command came from Allah: 'Proclaim openly all that you are commanded.'

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: كَثُرَ الْأَذَى وَهُوَ الصَّبُوْرُ لِرَبِّهِ ۞ وَهُوَ الشَّكُوْرُ وَكَانَ لَا يَتَوَانَى
passages.tr: Katsural-adzâ wa huwash-shabûru lirabbihi ۞ wa huwasy-syakûru wa kâna lâ yatawânâ
passages.id_: Datanglah bertubi-tubi berbagai gangguan. Namun, beliau ﷺ sangat sabar terhadap ketentuan Tuhannya, dan beliau ﷺ pandai bersyukur, dan tidak kendor dalam menjalankan misi dakwahnya.
passages.en: Harm came in wave upon wave. Yet he ﷺ was exceedingly patient with the decree of his Lord, and he ﷺ was ever grateful, never slackening in carrying out his mission of da'wah.

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: مَاتَتْ خَدِيْجَةُ وَأَبُوْ طَالِبٍ فِي الْـ ۞ ـخَمْسِيْنَ فَاشْتَدَّ الْأَذَاءُ فُنُوْنَا
passages.tr: Mâtat khadîjatu wa abû thâlibin fil- ۞ khamsîna fasytaddal-adzâ'u funûnâ
passages.id_: Kemudian wafatlah istrinya, Khadijah ra dan Abu Thalib (pamannya) ketika usia Nabi ﷺ genap 50 tahun. Sehingga semakin dahsyatlah gangguan yang beraneka ragam.
passages.en: Then his wife Khadijah (may Allah be pleased with her) and Abu Talib (his uncle) died when the Prophet ﷺ was fully 50 years old. So the harm of every kind grew all the more severe.

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: وَأَتَى ثَقِيْفًــــا دَاعِيًـــا فَرَمَوْهُ بِالْــ ۞ أَحْجَارِ بَلْ أَغْرَوْا بِهِ الصِّبْيَانَا
passages.tr: Wa atâ tsaqîfan dâ‘iyan faramauhu bil- ۞ aḫjâri bal aghrau bihish-shibyânâ
passages.id_: Beliau ﷺ berkunjung ke (Bani) Tsaqifah (Tha'if) untuk berdakwah. Di sana beliau ﷺ dilempari batu, bahkan digoda oleh anak-anak kecil.
passages.en: He ﷺ visited (the Bani) Thaqif (Ta'if) to call (to Islam). There he ﷺ was pelted with stones, and even taunted by small children.

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: مَلَكُ الْجِبَالِ أَتَى فَقَالَ اطْبِقُهَا ۞ فَقَالَ لَا، بَلْ أَرْتَجِي الْعُقْبَانَا
passages.tr: Malakul-jibâli atâ faqâlath-biquhâ ۞ faqâla lâ, bal artajil-‘uqbânâ
passages.id_: Datanglah malaikat penguasa gunung dan berkata: “Apakah kutimpakan (gunung Uhud) di atas mereka (Bani Tsaqifah)?” Beliau ﷺ berkata: Tidak! Bahkan aku berharap generasi mereka di kemudian hari (mendapat petunjuk).
passages.en: The angel in charge of the mountains came and said, 'Shall I crush (Mount Uhud) upon them (the Bani Thaqif)?' He ﷺ said, 'No! Rather I hope their later generations (will be guided).'

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: أَسْرَى بِهِ الْمَوْلَى وَصَـــلَّى خَلْفَــهُ الرُّ ۞ سْلُ وَشَاهَدَ بَرْزَخًا وَجِنَانَا
passages.tr: Asrâ bihil-maulâ wa shalla khalfahur-ru- ۞ slu wa syâhada barzakhan wa jinânâ
passages.id_: Lalu Sang Maha Pencipta memperjalankan beliau ﷺ (ke Masjidil Aqsha), lalu para rasul bermakmum di belakangnya, yang beliau ﷺ kemudian menyaksikan (alam) barzakh dan surga.
passages.en: Then the Creator made him ﷺ journey (to Masjid al-Aqsa), and the messengers prayed behind him, and he ﷺ then witnessed the (realm of) barzakh and Paradise.

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: عَرَجَ الْحَبِيْبُ إِلَى السَّمٰوَاتِ الْعُلَى ۞ وَالْعَرْشِ وَالْكُرْسِيْ رَأَى مَوْلَانَا
passages.tr: ‘arajal-ḫabîbu ilas-samawâtil-‘ulâ ۞ wal-‘arsyi wal-kursiyyî ra'â maulânâ
passages.id_: Naiklah sang kekasih ﷺ menembus langit-langit tertinggi, al-Arsy, dan al-Kursi, lalu berjumpa dengan Sang Tuan kita.
passages.en: The beloved ﷺ ascended, piercing the highest heavens, the Throne, and the Footstool, then met with our Master.

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: وَالْإِذْنُ بِالْهِجْرَةِ جَاءَ لِيَثْرِبٍ ۞ فَبِهِ ازْدَهَى الْبَلَدُ الْكَرِيْمُ وَزَانَا
passages.tr: Wal-idznu bil-hijrati jâ'a liyatsribin ۞ fabihiz-dahal-baladul-karîmu wa zânâ
passages.id_: Tibalah izin untuk hijrah ke Yatsrib (Madinah). Berkat Nabi ﷺ negeri itu bangkit dan menjadi indah.
passages.en: The permission came to migrate to Yathrib (Madinah). By the Prophet ﷺ that land rose and became beautiful.

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: فَأَقَامَ عَشْرًا دَاعِيًا وَمُجَـاهِدًا ۞ وَصَحَابُهُ كَانُوْا لَهُ أَعْوَانَا
passages.tr: Fa aqâma ‘asyran dâ’iyan wa mujâhidan ۞ wa shâḫâbuhu kânû lahu a‘wânâ
passages.id_: Nabi ﷺ pun bermukim di Madinah selama sepuluh tahun sebagai dai dan pejuang dengan dukungan para sahabatnya.
passages.en: The Prophet ﷺ dwelt in Madinah for ten years as a caller and a warrior, with the support of his companions.

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: لَا يَرْفَعُوْنَ إِذَا أَتَى أَصْوَاتَهُـــمْ ۞ بَلْ لَا يُحِدُّوْنَ الْبَصَرْ إِمْعَانَا
passages.tr: Lâ yarfa‘ûna idzâ atâ ashwâtahum ۞ bal lâ yuḫiddûnal-bashar im‘ânâ
passages.id_: Mereka (para sahabat) tidaklah meninggikan suara ketika di hadapan beliau ﷺ. Bahkan tak berani memandang beliau ﷺ.
passages.en: They (the companions) never raised their voices in his presence ﷺ. They did not even dare to gaze upon him ﷺ.

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: قَدْرًا وَتَعْظِيْمًا لِشَأْنِ مُحَمَّـدٍ ۞ إِذْ قَدْ تَلَوْا فِيْ فَضْلِهِ قُرْاٰنَا
passages.tr: Qadran wa ta‘dhîman lisya'ni muḫammadin ۞ idz qad talau fî fadllihi qur'ânâ
passages.id_: (Sikap itu) sebagai penghormatan dan pengagungan terhadap keutamaan Nabi Muhammad ﷺ yang telah mereka baca dan temukan dalam Al-Qur'an.
passages.en: (This conduct was) out of honour and magnifying of the excellence of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, which they had read and found in the Qur'an.

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: وَلَقَدْ رَأَوْا مِنْ خُلُقِهِ عَجَبًـا وَكَمْ ۞ قَدْ شَاهَدُوْا مَاحَيَّرَ الْأَذْهَانَا
passages.tr: Wa laqad ra'aû min khuluqihi ‘ajaban wa kam ۞ qad syâhadû mâ ḫayyaral-adzhânâ
passages.id_: Sungguh mereka telah melihat sesuatu yang menakjubkan dari budi pekerti beliau dan banyak pula mereka menyaksikan hal yang sukar dijangkau akal pikiran (mukjizat).
passages.en: Truly they saw wondrous things in his character, and much they witnessed that is beyond the reach of the mind (miracles).

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: كَرَمًا وَعَفْوًا وَالسَّخَا وَتَوَاضُعًـا ۞ وَالْجِذْعَ حَنَّ مَحَبَّةً وَحَنَانَا
passages.tr: Karaman wa ‘afwan was-sakhâ wa tawâdlu‘an ۞ wal-jidz‘a ḫanna maḫabbatan wa ḫanânâ
passages.id_: (Mereka menyaksikan) kemurahhatiannya, sikap pemaafnya, kedermawanannya, dan kerendahhatiannya—batang kurma pun menangis rindu karena cintanya terhadap Nabi ﷺ.
passages.en: (They witnessed) his generosity, his forgiveness, his liberality, and his humility — even the palm-trunk wept with longing out of its love for the Prophet ﷺ.

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: وَالْمَـــاءَ مِنْ بَيْنِ الْأَصَابِعِ نَابِعًا ۞ وَالْجَيْشَ أَضْحَى شَارِبًا رَيَّانَا
passages.tr: Wal-mâ'a min bainil-ashâbi‘i nâbi‘an ۞ wal-jaisya adlhâ syâriban rayyânâ
passages.id_: (Mereka juga menyaksikan) air memancar dari sela-sela jarinya ﷺ, lalu pasukan (sahabat beliau ﷺ) meminumnya hingga hilanglah dahaga mereka semuanya.
passages.en: (They also witnessed) water gushing from between his fingers ﷺ, and the army (of his companions ﷺ) drank of it until the thirst of them all was gone.

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: وَاللهِ قَدْ عَظُمَتْ مَعَاجِزُ أَحْمَدٍ ۞ رَفَعَ الْمُهَيْمِنُ لِلنَّبِيِّ مَكَانَا
passages.tr: Wallâhi qad ‘adhumat ma‘âjizu aḫmadin ۞ rafa‘al-muhaiminu lin-nabiyyi makânâ
passages.id_: Demi Allah, mukjizat-mukjizat Ahmad ﷺ itu mulia. Sang Maha Memelihara telah mengangkat Nabi ﷺ ke derajat yang setinggi-tingginya.
passages.en: By Allah, the miracles of Ahmad ﷺ are noble. The All-Preserving raised the Prophet ﷺ to the very highest rank.

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: وَلَقَدْ غَزَا سَبْعًا وَعِشْرِيْنَ مَعَ الصَّــ ۞ ـحْبِ رِجَالًا قَدْ مَشَوْا رُكْبَانَا
passages.tr: Wa laqad ghazâ sab‘an wa isyrîna ma‘ash-sha- ۞ ḫbi rijâlan qad masyau rukbânâ
passages.id_: Beliau ﷺ telah berjihad selama hidupnya sebanyak 27 kali bersama para sahabatnya dengan berjalan kaki atau berkendara dalam kafilah.
passages.en: He ﷺ waged jihad during his life 27 times together with his companions, on foot or riding in the caravan.

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: أَكْرِمْ بِـــهِ وَبِصَـحْبِــــهِ وَبِتَـــــابِعٍ ۞ يَا رَبِّ أَلْحِقْنَا بِهِمْ إِحْسَانَا
passages.tr: Akrim bihi wa bishaḫbihi wa bitâbi‘in ۞ yâ rabbi al-ḫiqnâ bihim iḫsânâ
passages.id_: Muliankanlah Nabi ﷺ, para sahabatnya, serta para tabi'in. Wahai Tuhan kami jadikan kami mengikuti jejak mereka dalam perbuatan baik.
passages.en: Honour the Prophet ﷺ, his companions, and the tabi'in. O our Lord, make us follow in their footsteps in doing good.

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: يَا رَبَّنَــــا صَــــلِّ وَسَــــلِّمْ دَائِمًــــــا ۞ عَلَى حَبِيْبِكَ مَنْ إِلَيْكَ دَعَانَا
passages.tr: Yâ rabbânâ shalli wa sallim da'iman ۞ ‘alâ ḫabîbika man ilaika da‘ânâ
passages.id_: Wahai Tuhan kami, limpahkanlah rahmat dan keselamatan selamanya pada kekasih-Mu yang telah menyeru kami kepada-Mu.
passages.en: O our Lord, pour mercy and peace forever upon Your beloved who called us to You.

passages.sub: Part VII: And Jibril Came to Him…
passages.ar: ﴿اَللّٰهمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وعَلَى اٰلِهِ﴾
passages.tr: ﴾Allâhumma shalli wa sallim wa bârik ‘alaihi wa ‘ala âlihi﴿
passages.id_: Ya Allah limpahkanlah rahmat keagungan, keselamatan, serta keberkahan kepada Nabi dan keluarganya.
passages.en: O Allah, pour the mercy of majesty, peace, and blessing upon the Prophet and his family.

passages.sub: Supplication of Mawlid adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: الدعـــاء
passages.tr: Ad-du’â
passages.id_: Doa
passages.en: Supplication (Du'a)

passages.sub: Supplication of Mawlid adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
passages.tr: Bismillâhirraḫmânirraḫîmi
passages.id_: Dengan menyebut nama Allah yang Maha Pengasih lagi Maha Penyayang.
passages.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

passages.sub: Supplication of Mawlid adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ، اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْأَوَّلِيْنَ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْآخِرِيْنَ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي النَّبِيِّيْنَ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْـمَـلَأِ الْأَعْلَى إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ أَجْمَعِيْنَ
passages.tr: Al-ḫâmdulillâhi rabbil-‘âlamîna, allâḫumma shalli wa sallim ‘alâ sayyidinâ muḫâmmadin fil-awwalîn, wa shalli wa sallim ‘alâ sayyidinâ muḫammadin fil-âkhirîna, wa shalli wa sallim ‘alâ sayyidina muḫammadin fin-nabiyyîna, wa shalli wa sallim ‘alâ sayyidina muḫammadin fil-mursalîna, wa shalli wa sallim ‘alâ sayyidina muḫammadin fil-malâ'il-a‘lâ ilâ yaumid-dîni, wa shalli wa sallim ‘alâ sayyidina muḫammadin wa ‘alâ âlihi wa shaḫbihi ajma‘îna.
passages.id_: Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan seluruh keberadaan. ”Ya Allah, limpahkanlah rahmat dan keselamatan kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad ﷺ bersama orang-orang permulaan, limpahkanlah rahmat dan keselamatan kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad ﷺ bersama orang-orang terakhir, dan limpahkanlah rahmat dan keselamatan kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad ﷺ bersama para nabi, limpahkanlah rahmat dan keselamatan kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad ﷺ bersama para rasul, serta limpahkanlah rahmat dan keselamatan kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad ﷺ bersama para nabi orang-orang yang memiliki kemuliaan sampai hari kiamat. Limpahkanlah rahmat dan keselamatan kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad ﷺ , keluarga, dan sahabatnya secara keseluruhan.
passages.en: All praise is due to Allah, Lord of all existence. 'O Allah, pour mercy and peace upon our master Prophet Muhammad ﷺ among the first ones; pour mercy and peace upon our master Prophet Muhammad ﷺ among the last ones; pour mercy and peace upon our master Prophet Muhammad ﷺ among the prophets; pour mercy and peace upon our master Prophet Muhammad ﷺ among the messengers; and pour mercy and peace upon our master Prophet Muhammad ﷺ among the prophets, those possessed of honour, until the Day of Resurrection. Pour mercy and peace upon our master Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, his family, and his companions all together.'

passages.sub: Supplication of Mawlid adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَشَرْتُ لِنَعْتِ مَنْ أَوْصَافُهُ ۞ تُحْيِي الْقُلُوْبَ تُهَيِّجُ الْأَشْجَانَا
passages.tr: Wa laqad asyartu lina‘ti man aushâfuhu ۞ tuḫyil-qulûba tuhayyijul-asyjânâ
passages.id_: Telah kutunjukkan sifat-sifat Nabi ﷺ yang menghidupkan hati, mengguncang aneka kegelisahan.
passages.en: I have shown the traits of the Prophet ﷺ that give life to the heart and shake away every anxiety.

passages.sub: Supplication of Mawlid adh-Dhiya' al-Lami'
passages.ar: وَاللهُ قَدْ أَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ فَمَا يُسَــا ۞ وِيْ الْقَوْلُ مِنَّا أَوْ يَكُوْنُ ثَنَانَا
